title: In-class Exercise 4: Geographically Weighted Summary Statistics
section: From sf to sp
text:
From sf to sp
GWmodel predates the simple features standard and its functions expect a Spatial*DataFrame from the older sp class system. as_Spatial() performs the conversion:

hunan_sp <- hunan_sf %>%
  as_Spatial()

Two objects now describe the same 88 counties. hunan_sp is the input for GWmodel, and hunan_sf remains the object tmap is given at the end. Results come back from gwss() in the order of the rows that went in, which is what makes the cbind() in the mapping sections legitimate. That join is positional rather than by key, so nothing between here and there may reorder or filter either object.

title: In-class Exercise 4: Geographically Weighted Summary Statistics
section: Determining the Bandwidth
text:
Determining the Bandwidth
The bandwidth is the one parameter that decides how local “local” is, and it is chosen by optimisation rather than by hand. bw.gwr() searches for the value that minimises a chosen criterion. CV is leave-one-out cross-validation, scoring how well each location is predicted from its neighbours; AIC penalises model complexity instead.
The search is run against the intercept-only model GDPPC ~ 1, since what is wanted is a bandwidth for describing GDPPC locally, not for regressing it on anything.

Adaptive bandwidth
An adaptive bandwidth holds the number of neighbours constant and lets the radius stretch or contract, so the kernel covers as many counties in the sparse west as in the dense north-east:

bw_CV_adaptive <- bw.gwr(GDPPC ~ 1,
                         data = hunan_sp,
                         approach = "CV",
                         adaptive = TRUE,
                         kernel = "bisquare",
                         longlat = TRUE)

bw_AIC_adaptive <- bw.gwr(GDPPC ~ 1,
                          data = hunan_sp,
                          approach = "AIC",
                          adaptive = TRUE,
                          kernel = "bisquare",
                          longlat = TRUE)



Fixed bandwidth
A fixed bandwidth holds the radius constant instead, and the neighbour count varies with local density:

bw_CV_fixed <- bw.gwr(GDPPC ~ 1,
                      data = hunan_sp,
                      approach = "CV",
                      adaptive = FALSE,
                      kernel = "bisquare",
                      longlat = TRUE)

bw_AIC_fixed <- bw.gwr(GDPPC ~ 1,
                       data = hunan_sp,
                       approach = "AIC",
                       adaptive = FALSE,
                       kernel = "bisquare",
                       longlat = TRUE)


tibble(Bandwidth = c("Adaptive", "Adaptive", "Fixed", "Fixed"),
       Criterion = c("CV", "AIC", "CV", "AIC"),
       Value = c(bw_CV_adaptive, bw_AIC_adaptive,
                 bw_CV_fixed, bw_AIC_fixed),
       Unit = c("nearest neighbours", "nearest neighbours", "km", "km")) %>%
  kable(digits = 2)




Bandwidth
Criterion
Value
Unit




Adaptive
CV
22.00
nearest neighbours


Adaptive
AIC
22.00
nearest neighbours


Fixed
CV
76.29
km


Fixed
AIC
160.55
km





The two criteria behave differently depending on which kind of bandwidth they are searching over.
On the adaptive side, CV and AIC both settle on 22 nearest neighbours. Agreement between two criteria that optimise different things is the strongest evidence available here that 22 is a feature of the data rather than an artefact of the search. It amounts to a quarter of the province, which is a defensible reading of “local”.
On the fixed side, CV returns 76.3 km and AIC returns 160.6 km, more than double. That disagreement is diagnostic rather than a failure of either method. Hunan’s counties vary greatly in area, so a single radius means a different sample size everywhere it is placed. CV, scored point by point, chases the radius that fits the densest parts, while AIC tolerates a much broader kernel for the province as a whole. When a fixed bandwidth makes the two criteria disagree this sharply and an adaptive one makes them agree exactly, the adaptive specification is the one the data supports.

title: In-class Exercise 4: Geographically Weighted Summary Statistics
section: Geographically Weighted Summary Statistics
text:
Geographically Weighted Summary Statistics
gwss() computes the summary statistics at every location, each one weighted by the kernel. Setting quantile = TRUE adds the robust family, meaning the local median, interquartile range and quantile imbalance, alongside the moment-based statistics:

gwstat <- gwss(data = hunan_sp,
               vars = "GDPPC",
               bw = bw_AIC_adaptive,
               kernel = "bisquare",
               quantile = TRUE,
               adaptive = TRUE,
               longlat = TRUE)


names(as.data.frame(gwstat$SDF))

[1] "GDPPC_LM"     "GDPPC_LSD"    "GDPPC_LVar"   "GDPPC_LSKe"   "GDPPC_LCV"   
[6] "GDPPC_Median" "GDPPC_IQR"    "GDPPC_QI"    


Eight surfaces for a single variable: local mean, standard deviation, variance, skewness and coefficient of variation from the moment-based side, then median, IQR and quantile imbalance from the robust side. Each is a vector of 88 values, one per county, rather than a single number.

Preparing the output
gwss() returns its results in the SDF slot as a Spatial*DataFrame. Extracting the data table and binding it column-wise to hunan_sf restores a mappable sf object:

gwstat_df <- as.data.frame(gwstat$SDF)

hunan_gstat <- cbind(hunan_sf, gwstat_df)



Visualising the geographically weighted mean

tm_shape(hunan_gstat) +
  tm_polygons(fill = "GDPPC_LM",
              fill.scale = tm_scale_intervals(
                style = "quantile",
                n = 5,
                values = "brewer.blues"),
              fill.legend = tm_legend(
                title = "Local mean")) +
  tm_borders(col = "grey70", lwd = 0.4) +
  tm_title("Geographically weighted mean of GDPPC, 22 nearest neighbours",
           size = 1.1)










The local mean against the global one

tibble(Statistic = c("Global mean", "Local mean, minimum", "Local mean, maximum",
                     "Global median", "Local median, minimum", "Local median, maximum"),
       GDPPC = c(mean(hunan_sf$GDPPC),
                 min(hunan_gstat$GDPPC_LM), max(hunan_gstat$GDPPC_LM),
                 median(hunan_sf$GDPPC),
                 min(hunan_gstat$GDPPC_Median), max(hunan_gstat$GDPPC_Median))) %>%
  kable(digits = 0, format.args = list(big.mark = ","))




Statistic
GDPPC




Global mean
24,405


Local mean, minimum
13,689


Local mean, maximum
49,006


Global median
20,433


Local median, minimum
11,580


Local median, maximum
41,491





Conventional analysis would report one number for Hunan, a mean GDPPC of 24,405 yuan. The geographically weighted mean replaces it with 88, running from 13,689 around Wugang in Shaoyang to 49,006 at Changsha, a 3.6-fold spread the single figure conceals entirely. This is spatial non-stationarity made measurable: the provincial average describes nowhere in particular, because the north-east corridor and the south-western uplands are not samples from the same population.
The smoothing is substantial and deliberate. Raw GDPPC ranges from 8,497 to 88,656, so the local mean surface compresses a 10-fold spread into a 3.6-fold one. What survives that compression is the regional signal, and what is removed is the county-level idiosyncrasy a spatial lag would have retained.


Robust statistics: local mean against local median
The moment-based and robust families are computed from the same kernel, so comparing them isolates the effect of the outliers rather than the effect of location:

lm_map <- tm_shape(hunan_gstat) +
  tm_polygons(fill = "GDPPC_LM",
              fill.scale = tm_scale_intervals(
                style = "quantile", n = 5, values = "brewer.blues"),
              fill.legend = tm_legend(title = "Local mean")) +
  tm_borders(col = "grey70", lwd = 0.4) +
  tm_title("Local mean", size = 1.0)

med_map <- tm_shape(hunan_gstat) +
  tm_polygons(fill = "GDPPC_Median",
              fill.scale = tm_scale_intervals(
                style = "quantile", n = 5, values = "brewer.blues"),
              fill.legend = tm_legend(title = "Local median")) +
  tm_borders(col = "grey70", lwd = 0.4) +
  tm_title("Local median", size = 1.0)

tmap_arrange(lm_map, med_map, asp = 1, ncol = 2)









summary(hunan_gstat$GDPPC_LM / hunan_gstat$GDPPC_Median)

   Min. 1st Qu.  Median    Mean 3rd Qu.    Max. 
 0.9186  1.0918  1.1473  1.1737  1.2298  1.6355 


The two maps share a pattern but not a level. The ratio of local mean to local median exceeds 1 almost everywhere, reaching 1.64. In the neighbourhoods around Changsha the weighted mean sits 64% above the weighted median, because a handful of very rich counties pull it upward while the median ignores them by construction.
That gap is itself the finding. Where mean and median agree, the local distribution is symmetric and either statistic describes the neighbourhood honestly. Where they diverge this far, the neighbourhood contains counties unlike their surroundings, and the mean surface is reporting their influence rather than the typical county. The robust surface is the more defensible description of the north-east, and the divergence between the two is more informative than either alone.

title: In-class Exercise 4: Geographically Weighted Summary Statistics
section: The Effect of the Bandwidth
text:
The Effect of the Bandwidth
Repeating the computation under the fixed bandwidth shows what the choice made in the previous section actually bought:

gwstat_fixed <- gwss(data = hunan_sp,
                     vars = "GDPPC",
                     bw = bw_AIC_fixed,
                     kernel = "bisquare",
                     adaptive = FALSE,
                     quantile = FALSE,
                     longlat = TRUE)

hunan_gstat_fixed <- cbind(hunan_sf, as.data.frame(gwstat_fixed$SDF))


adaptive_map <- tm_shape(hunan_gstat) +
  tm_polygons(fill = "GDPPC_LM",
              fill.scale = tm_scale_intervals(
                style = "quantile", n = 5, values = "brewer.blues"),
              fill.legend = tm_legend(title = "Local mean")) +
  tm_borders(col = "grey70", lwd = 0.4) +
  tm_title("Adaptive, 22 neighbours", size = 1.0)

fixed_map <- tm_shape(hunan_gstat_fixed) +
  tm_polygons(fill = "GDPPC_LM",
              fill.scale = tm_scale_intervals(
                style = "quantile", n = 5, values = "brewer.blues"),
              fill.legend = tm_legend(title = "Local mean")) +
  tm_borders(col = "grey70", lwd = 0.4) +
  tm_title("Fixed, 160.6 km", size = 1.0)

tmap_arrange(adaptive_map, fixed_map, asp = 1, ncol = 2)








The 160.6 km fixed kernel produces a local mean surface spanning 14,259 to 47,833, close to the adaptive result but reached for a different reason. A fixed radius over Hunan’s uneven county sizes draws on roughly thirty counties in the compact north-east and barely a dozen in the large western ones, so the western estimates rest on fewest observations exactly where the counties are largest. The CV bandwidth of 76.3 km makes this visible: at that radius the local mean runs from 10,135 to 72,045, a surface so close to the raw data that it has stopped summarising anything.
The adaptive kernel removes that dependence by construction, which is why it is the appropriate specification for administrative areas of unequal size, the usual case.

title: In-class Exercise 4: Geographically Weighted Summary Statistics
section: Geographically Weighted Correlation
text:
Geographically Weighted Correlation
The same kernel machinery applies to a statistic computed from two variables. The question is whether the relationship between GDP per capita and gross industrial output holds with equal strength across the province.

The conventional analysis first
ggscatterstats() gives the global answer, one coefficient for all 88 counties, with its test:

ggscatterstats(data = hunan_sf %>% st_drop_geometry(),
               x = GIO,
               y = GDPPC,
               xlab = "Gross Industrial Output",
               ylab = "GDP per capita",
               label.var = County,
               label.expression = GIO > 20000 & GDPPC > 50000,
               point.label.args = list(alpha = 0.7, size = 4, color = "grey50"),
               xfill = "#CC79A7",
               yfill = "#009E73",
               title = "Relationship between GDP per capita and Gross Industrial Output")








Pearson’s r = 0.77 and clearly significant, a strong positive relationship, and the analysis would conventionally stop there.


Determining the bandwidth
The bandwidth for a two-variable statistic is selected from the corresponding regression, so the formula now carries GIO on the right-hand side:

bw_corr <- bw.gwr(GDPPC ~ GIO,
                  data = hunan_sp,
                  approach = "AICc",
                  adaptive = TRUE)


bw_corr

[1] 84




Computing the correlation surface

gwstats_corr <- gwss(hunan_sp,
                     vars = c("GDPPC", "GIO"),
                     bw = bw_corr,
                     kernel = "bisquare",
                     adaptive = TRUE,
                     longlat = TRUE)

Two variables produce the five univariate surfaces twice over, followed by three bivariate ones. They are selected by name rather than by column position, so that a change of quantile or of vars cannot silently shift the wrong columns into the map:

gwcorr_df <- as.data.frame(gwstats_corr$SDF) %>%
  select(gwCorr = Corr_GDPPC.GIO,
         gwSpearman = Spearman_rho_GDPPC.GIO)

hunan_corr <- cbind(hunan_sf, gwcorr_df)



Visualising the local Spearman coefficient

tm_shape(hunan_corr) +
  tm_polygons(fill = "gwSpearman",
              fill.scale = tm_scale_intervals(
                style = "quantile",
                n = 5,
                values = "brewer.blues"),
              fill.legend = tm_legend(
                title = "Local Spearman's rho")) +
  tm_borders(col = "grey70", lwd = 0.4) +
  tm_title("Geographically weighted correlation, GDPPC and GIO", size = 1.1)









tibble(Coefficient = c("Pearson", "Spearman"),
       Global = c(cor(hunan_sf$GDPPC, hunan_sf$GIO),
                  cor(hunan_sf$GDPPC, hunan_sf$GIO, method = "spearman")),
       `Local minimum` = c(min(hunan_corr$gwCorr), min(hunan_corr$gwSpearman)),
       `Local maximum` = c(max(hunan_corr$gwCorr), max(hunan_corr$gwSpearman))) %>%
  kable(digits = 3)




Coefficient
Global
Local minimum
Local maximum




Pearson
0.765
0.682
0.761


Spearman
0.732
0.579
0.733











WarningThe bandwidth has flattened the surface



The selected bandwidth is 84 of 88 counties. Every local correlation is therefore computed from almost the entire province, and the result is what that implies: local Pearson spans 0.682 to 0.761 around a global 0.765, and local Spearman 0.579 to 0.733 around a global 0.732. The map above is close to a constant.
This is not a null finding about Hunan. It is a consequence of where the bandwidth came from. bw.gwr() selected 84 as the bandwidth at which a regression of GDPPC on GIO is best supported, and a near-global bandwidth is the correct answer to that question when the relationship is genuinely strong everywhere. But the statistic being mapped is not that regression, and a criterion chosen for one is not automatically valid for the other.


Recomputing on the bandwidth the data itself supported earlier, the 22 neighbours on which CV and AIC agreed, asks the intended question:

gwstats_local <- gwss(hunan_sp,
                      vars = c("GDPPC", "GIO"),
                      bw = bw_AIC_adaptive,
                      kernel = "bisquare",
                      adaptive = TRUE,
                      longlat = TRUE)

hunan_corr22 <- cbind(hunan_sf,
                      as.data.frame(gwstats_local$SDF) %>%
                        select(gwCorr = Corr_GDPPC.GIO,
                               gwSpearman = Spearman_rho_GDPPC.GIO))


corr84 <- tm_shape(hunan_corr) +
  tm_polygons(fill = "gwCorr",
              fill.scale = tm_scale_intervals(
                style = "fixed",
                breaks = c(0, 0.2, 0.4, 0.6, 0.8, 1),
                values = "brewer.blues"),
              fill.legend = tm_legend(title = "Local r")) +
  tm_borders(col = "grey70", lwd = 0.4) +
  tm_title("bw = 84 neighbours", size = 1.0)

corr22 <- tm_shape(hunan_corr22) +
  tm_polygons(fill = "gwCorr",
              fill.scale = tm_scale_intervals(
                style = "fixed",
                breaks = c(0, 0.2, 0.4, 0.6, 0.8, 1),
                values = "brewer.blues"),
              fill.legend = tm_legend(title = "Local r")) +
  tm_borders(col = "grey70", lwd = 0.4) +
  tm_title("bw = 22 neighbours", size = 1.0)

tmap_arrange(corr84, corr22, asp = 1, ncol = 2)









summary(hunan_corr22$gwCorr)

   Min. 1st Qu.  Median    Mean 3rd Qu.    Max. 
 0.1768  0.5631  0.6583  0.6351  0.7507  0.8744 


On the same colour scale the left map is one shade and the right map is four. At 22 neighbours the local Pearson correlation runs from 0.18 to 0.87, and local Spearman from 0.12 to 0.92. The relationship the global coefficient reports as uniformly strong is strong in some parts of Hunan and close to absent in others.
Both maps are correct at their own bandwidth, and they answer different questions. The left one asks whether industrial output predicts GDP per capita across Hunan, and the answer is yes, consistently. The right one asks whether a county’s prosperity tracks its industry among its own neighbours, and the answer is that it depends where the county is. In the industrial north-east the two move together closely, while in the west a county’s GDP per capita owes comparatively little to its industrial output.
The conclusion concerns method rather than Hunan. Bandwidth is not a nuisance parameter to be delegated to a selection routine. It declares the scale at which a question is being asked, and a bandwidth optimised for one statistic can suppress precisely the variation another statistic exists to reveal.

title: Take-home Exercise 1: Fire on Drained Peat课后作业一：排水泥炭地上的火
section: Abstract摘要
text:
Abstract摘要

Pulang Pisau Regency holds much of the drainage network left behind by Indonesia’s abandoned Mega Rice Project, and it burns in almost every dry season. This report treats 3,101 VIIRS 375 m active-fire detections, recorded inside the regency between 4 and 11 September 2026, as one realisation of a spatial and spatio-temporal point process.
Detection intensity varies about fortyfold across the regency. It rises sharply close to engineered canals and falls close to natural rivers. The two effects keep opposite signs after multivariate adjustment, and that is what separates a drainage mechanism from simple proximity to water.
The second-order analysis is built around a sequence of null models, and its main result is methodological. A homogeneous Poisson null is rejected, but the rejection carries no information. A kernel-based inhomogeneous Poisson null then gives opposite answers at different intensity bandwidths. It is not rejected at 1–2 km. At 10 km it is rejected decisively. We read this as a problem of identifiability and statistical power, not as a finding about fire. The p-value falls monotonically as the null becomes less flexible, so the verdict is tracking the model and not the data. Replacing the kernel with a parsimonious parametric null breaks the impasse. A covariate-driven Poisson process is rejected. A Thomas cluster process carrying the same trend is not, and it estimates compact clusters of roughly 2.1 km.
A Monte-Carlo Knox test on permuted dates then establishes genuine space-time interaction, using no bandwidth and no covariates at all. Throughout, the analysis keeps the behaviour of the fire field separate from the behaviour of the satellite. That distinction accounts for most of the apparent day-to-day variation.


Pulang Pisau 县境内保留着印尼「百万公顷稻米工程」遗留的大片排水渠网,几乎每个 旱季都会过火。本报告把 2026 年 9 月 4 日至 11 日该县记录到的 3,101 个 VIIRS 375 m 活跃火点探测,视为一次空间与时空点过程的实现加以分析。
一阶分析显示,探测强度在全县范围内相差约四十倍。它在人工运河附近明显升高, 在天然河流附近反而降低。两者的方向在多变量调整之后依然相反,正是这一点把 排水机制与泛泛的「靠水」区分开来。
二阶分析围绕一组逐层放宽的零模型展开,其主要结果属于方法学层面。齐次泊松 零模型被拒绝,但这一拒绝不提供任何信息。改用基于核的非齐次泊松零模型之后,不同的 强度带宽给出了相反的答案:在 1–2 km 下不被拒绝,在 10 km 下被决定性地拒绝。 我们把它判断为可识别性与检验力的问题,而不是关于火本身的发现。随着零模型变得 不那么灵活,p 值单调下降,说明判定追踪的是模型而不是数据。把核估计换成一个简约的 参数化零模型可以打破僵局。由协变量驱动的泊松过程被拒绝;带有同一趋势项的 Thomas 聚集过程没有被拒绝,并估计出约 2.1 km 的紧凑簇群。
随后,在置换日期上进行的蒙特卡洛 Knox 检验确立了真实的时空交互,整个过程既不使用 带宽,也不使用任何协变量。全篇始终把火场的行为与卫星的行为分开来看。这一区分 解释了逐日表观变化中的大部分。

section: 1.1 Why peatland fire is a public-safety problem泥炭地火灾为何是公共安全问题
text:
1.1 Why peatland fire is a public-safety problem泥炭地火灾为何是公共安全问题

Public safety in the Indonesian peatland provinces is shaped every dry season by fire. The hazard is not primarily flame. Peat burns below ground, slowly, over weeks, and its dominant health impact is transboundary smoke: the 1997 Indonesian peat and forest fires released on the order of 0.81–2.57 Gt of carbon, an amount comparable to a substantial fraction of annual global fossil fuel emissions at the time (Page et al., 2002), and Indonesian fire activity has been shown to respond non-linearly to El Niño-induced drought, so that moderate increases in dryness produce disproportionate increases in smoke pollution (Field et al., 2016). The exposed population is large, the exposure pathway is respiratory, and the events that generate it are spatially discrete ignitions that can, in principle, be anticipated and prevented.
Pulang Pisau Regency, in Central Kalimantan, is a particularly consequential place to study this. Between 1995 and 1999 the Indonesian government’s Mega Rice Project (Proyek Lahan Gambut Sejuta Hektar) attempted to convert approximately one million hectares of peat swamp forest in Central Kalimantan to rice cultivation. Several thousand kilometres of drainage canals were excavated before the project was terminated by Presidential Decree 80/1999 (Ritzema et al., 2014). The canals remain. They lower the peat water table, the dried peat becomes combustible, and the area has burned repeatedly since (Hoscilo et al., 2011; Konecny et al., 2016). Ignition itself is overwhelmingly human: Cattau et al. (2016) attribute the great majority of ignitions on this landscape to land preparation and related activity rather than natural causes.
That combination (an engineered hydrological cause, a human ignition source, and a recurring seasonal hazard) makes the location and timing of fire events the natural object of analysis, and makes point pattern analysis the natural method.


印尼泥炭地各省的公共安全,每年旱季都由火灾主导。真正的危害主要不是明火。泥炭在地下缓慢燃烧,可持续数周,其主要健康影响是跨境烟霾:1997 年印尼泥炭与森林大火释放了约 0.81–2.57 Gt 碳,相当于当时全球年度化石燃料排放量的可观比例 (Page et al., 2002);研究还表明印尼火灾活动对厄尔尼诺引发的干旱呈非线性响应,即干燥程度的中等增加会带来烟霾污染的不成比例上升 (Field et al., 2016)。暴露人口规模大,暴露途径是呼吸道,而产生烟霾的事件是空间上离散的点火行为,原则上可以预判、也可以预防。
中加里曼丹的 Pulang Pisau 县是研究这一问题特别有意义的地点。1995 至 1999 年间,印尼政府的”百万公顷稻米工程”(Proyek Lahan Gambut Sejuta Hektar)试图将中加里曼丹约一百万公顷泥炭沼泽林改造为稻田。在工程被第 80/1999 号总统令终止之前,已开挖了数千公里排水运河 (Ritzema et al., 2014)。这些运河至今仍在。它们压低泥炭地下水位,干化的泥炭变得可燃,此后该地区反复过火 (Hoscilo et al., 2011; Konecny et al., 2016)。点火源则绝大多数来自人为:Cattau 等人 (2016) 将该景观上的绝大部分点火归因于土地整备及相关活动,而非自然原因。
这三者的组合(一个工程性的水文成因、一个人为点火源、以及一个反复出现的季节性灾害)使火灾事件的位置与时间成为自然的分析对象,也使点模式分析成为自然的方法。

title: Take-home Exercise 1: Fire on Drained Peat课后作业一：排水泥炭地上的火
section: 1.2 Why point pattern analysis, and what it can and cannot say为什么用点模式分析,以及它能说与不能说什么
text:
1.2 Why point pattern analysis, and what it can and cannot say为什么用点模式分析,以及它能说与不能说什么

A set of satellite fire detections is a point pattern: a finite set of locations, in a bounded window, generated by a process we do not observe directly. Point pattern analysis distinguishes two properties of that process, and the distinction organises this entire report.


一组卫星火点探测就是一个点模式:在有界窗口内的有限位置集合,由一个我们无法直接观测的过程生成。点模式分析区分该过程的两种性质,而这一区分贯穿整份报告的组织结构。








NoteFirst-order and second-order properties



First-order properties concern the intensity function \(\lambda(u)\), the expected number of events per unit area at location \(u\). First-order analysis asks where are events more or less likely, and treats each location’s propensity as a property of the location.
Second-order properties concern interaction between events, whether the presence of an event at \(u\) changes the probability of an event near \(u\), over and above whatever \(\lambda(u)\) already implies. Second-order analysis asks do events attract, repel, or ignore one another.
The two are fundamentally confounded in a single realisation (A. Baddeley et al., 2015, ch. 7). A pattern with many points in one corner can be described either as high intensity there (first-order) or as clustering (second-order), and no amount of data from one realisation can separate them without an assumption. This report therefore does not pretend to separate them by choosing a better statistic; it separates them by stating an explicit assumption about the scale at which each operates, and then testing how much the conclusions depend on that assumption.










Note一阶性质与二阶性质



一阶性质关注强度函数 \(\lambda(u)\),位置 \(u\) 处单位面积的期望事件数。一阶分析问的是事件在哪里更容易发生、哪里更不容易,并把每个位置的倾向视为该位置本身的属性。
二阶性质关注事件之间的交互,\(u\) 处存在一个事件,是否会在 \(\lambda(u)\) 已隐含的程度之外,改变 \(u\) 附近出现事件的概率。二阶分析问的是事件之间相互吸引、相互排斥,还是彼此无关。
在单次实现中,这两者从根本上是混淆的 (A. Baddeley et al., 2015, ch. 7)。某个角落点很多的模式,既可以描述为那里强度高(一阶),也可以描述为聚集(二阶);仅凭一次实现的数据,无论多少,都无法在不引入假设的情况下把两者分开。因此这里并不假装靠挑一个更好的统计量来分离它们;而是通过明确陈述关于两者各自作用尺度的假设来分离,然后检验结论在多大程度上依赖该假设。




Equally important is what the data are. A FIRMS record is not a fire. It is a detection: a satellite pixel that a thermal anomaly algorithm flagged during one overpass (Schroeder et al., 2014). One fire can produce many detections; one fire can produce none, if it burns under cloud or between overpasses. Any pattern in the detections is therefore a pattern in
\[
\text{fire activity} \;\times\; \text{observation process},
\]
and separating these two is a data-quality problem before it is a statistical one. Section 4 returns to this, and Section 5.1 shows that in this dataset the observation process accounts for a large part of the apparent day-to-day variation.


同样重要的是数据究竟是什么。一条 FIRMS 记录不是一场火。它是一次探测:某次卫星过境时,热异常算法标记出来的一个像元 (Schroeder et al., 2014)。一场火可以产生许多条探测;一场火也可能一条都不产生,如果它在云层下燃烧,或在两次过境之间烧完。因此探测点中的任何模式,实际上是
\[
\text{火灾活动} \;\times\; \text{观测过程}
\]
的模式,而分离这两者首先是一个数据质量问题,其次才是统计问题。4 节会回到这一点,5.1 节则表明:在本数据集中,观测过程解释了逐日变化中的很大一部分。

title: Take-home Exercise 1: Fire on Drained Peat课后作业一：排水泥炭地上的火
section: 1.3 Research questions研究问题
text:
1.3 Research questions研究问题

The analysis is organised around six questions, three first-order and three second-order.


分析围绕六个问题展开,三个属于一阶,三个属于二阶。



RQ1 (first-order, space. How does the intensity of active-fire detection vary across Pulang Pisau Regency, and at what spatial scale can that variation legitimately be resolved given a 375 m sensor?


RQ2) first-order, time. Does detection intensity vary from day to day within the observation window, and can genuine variation in fire activity be distinguished from variation in satellite sampling?


RQ3 (first-order, covariates. Is detection intensity associated with proximity to the engineered drainage network, as distinct from proximity to natural rivers, roads, or settlements?


RQ4) second-order, space. After the large-scale intensity gradient is accounted for, do detections show evidence of clustering, inhibition, or approximate randomness (and over what range of distances?


RQ5) second-order, space-time. Is there space-time interaction: are detections that are close in space also close in time, beyond what their separate spatial and temporal patterns imply?


RQ6 (value added. Can measured drainage and access geography account for the observed clustering, or does excess clustering remain once that geography is modelled) and what generative process best describes it?




RQ1 (一阶,空间。 活跃火点探测强度在 Pulang Pisau 县内如何变化?在 375 m 分辨率传感器的前提下,这种变化在什么空间尺度上才是可以正当分辨的?


RQ2) 一阶,时间。 在观测窗口内,探测强度是否逐日变化?火灾活动的真实变化能否与卫星采样的变化区分开?


RQ3 (一阶,协变量。 探测强度是否与到人工排水网络的邻近度相关?这一关联能否与到天然河流、道路或居民点的邻近度区分开?


RQ4) 二阶,空间。 在扣除大尺度强度梯度之后,探测点是否表现出聚集、抑制或近似随机的证据?在什么距离范围内?


RQ5 (二阶,时空。 是否存在时空交互:空间上靠近的探测点在时间上是否也靠近,其程度是否超出各自的空间格局与时间格局所隐含的水平?


RQ6) 增值分析。 已测得的排水与可达性地理条件能否解释观测到的聚集?在对该地理条件建模之后是否仍有超额聚集?什么样的生成过程能最好地描述它?

title: Take-home Exercise 1: Fire on Drained Peat课后作业一：排水泥炭地上的火
section: 1.4 Objectives研究目标
text:
1.4 Objectives研究目标


Prepare and integrate satellite fire-detection data, official administrative boundaries and contextual infrastructure data into a defensible point pattern, with a complete and auditable record of every data-quality decision.
Characterise first-order properties in space, in time, and as a function of covariates.
Characterise second-order properties against explicitly justified null models rather than against a default one.
State and evaluate the assumptions each method requires, and quantify how far the conclusions depend on them.
Communicate the findings through geovisualisations and statistical graphics designed for analytical reading.
Translate the evidence into implications for public-safety planning, while separating what the analysis supports from what it does not.




将卫星火点探测数据、官方行政边界与背景基础设施数据准备并整合为一个站得住脚的点模式,并对每一项数据质量决策留下完整可审计的记录。
刻画空间上、时间上以及作为协变量函数的一阶性质。
针对有明确论证的零模型(而非默认零模型)刻画二阶性质。
陈述并评估每种方法所需的假设,并量化结论对这些假设的依赖程度。
通过为分析性阅读而设计的地理可视化与统计图形传达发现。
将证据转化为对公共安全规划的启示,同时区分分析支持的结论与分析不支持的结论。

m_ctx <- ggplot() +

m_area <- ggplot() +

Figure 1: Study area. Left: Pulang Pisau Regency within Kalimantan, with all VIIRS S-NPP detections recorded across the island in the same eight days. Right: the regency, its eight kecamatan, and the drainage geography that motivates the analysis.研究区。左:Pulang Pisau 县在加里曼丹岛中的位置,叠加同一八天内全岛的 VIIRS S-NPP 探测点。右:该县、其八个区(kecamatan),以及引出本研究问题的排水地理格局。






Across the island. Kalimantan burned widely in this week (22,763 S-NPP detections island-wide), but activity is patchy, and Pulang Pisau sits inside one of the densest southern clusters. Within the regency, the canal network (thin blue) is dense in the centre and south and sparse in the forested north, while natural rivers (thick blue) run broadly north–south. Settlements are few and align with the rivers and the canal grid. The visual expectation this sets up (that fire should follow the canal grid rather than the rivers) is tested formally in § 5.5 and should not be read off this map, which shows infrastructure, not fire. One limit: OSM completeness is uneven and is likely better near settlements, which could by itself produce an apparent canal–fire association.


放到全岛看。 本周加里曼丹全岛普遍过火(全岛 22,763 个 S-NPP 探测点)但活动呈斑块状,而 Pulang Pisau 正位于南部最密集的簇群之一。县内运河网络(细蓝线)在中部与南部密集、在北部林区 稀疏;天然河流(粗蓝线)大致南北走向。居民点数量不多,沿河流与运河格网分布。 本图建立的视觉预期(火应跟随运河格网而非河流)将在 § 5.5 中 正式检验,不应直接从本图读出结论:本图显示的是基础设施,不是火。 一点限度: OSM 完备性并不均匀,在居民点附近很可能更好,仅此一点就足以造成 「运河, 火」关联的假象。

title: Take-home Exercise 1: Fire on Drained Peat课后作业一：排水泥炭地上的火
section: 2.3 What counts as a point event什么算一个点事件
text:
2.3 What counts as a point event什么算一个点事件

This is the single most consequential definitional decision in the study, and it has no unique right answer.
A FIRMS record is one pixel-overpass: the algorithm flagged a 375 m pixel as containing active fire during one satellite pass (Schroeder et al., 2014). Treating each record as a point event therefore builds three kinds of duplication into the pattern:

Spatial duplication, a single burning area spans several adjacent pixels, all of which are flagged.
Temporal duplication within a day, S-NPP passes roughly twice daily, so a fire burning for a full day can be flagged twice at the same location.
Multi-day persistence, peat fires smoulder for days or weeks, and the same pixel recurs.

Only the third of these is a property of fire. The first two are properties of the sensor. Because they operate at scales (375 m; 0 m) below the scales at which any substantive question is posed, they would inflate exactly the small-distance clustering that a second-order analysis is designed to detect.
Three analysis units are therefore constructed, and every second-order result is reported for all three.


这是全研究中最具决定性影响的定义性抉择,而且它没有唯一正确的答案。
一条 FIRMS 记录是一次像元-过境:算法在某次卫星过境时把一个 375 m 像元标记为 含有活跃火 (Schroeder et al., 2014)。因此,若把每条记录都当作一个点事件,就会把三种重复 性内建进模式:

空间重复,一片燃烧区域横跨若干相邻像元,这些像元全部被标记。
日内时间重复,S-NPP 每天约过境两次,因此烧了一整天的火可能在同一位置被 标记两次。
跨日持续,泥炭火会阴燃数天甚至数周,同一像元反复出现。

其中只有第三种是火的性质,前两种是传感器的性质。由于它们作用的尺度 (375 m;0 m)低于任何实质性问题所设定的尺度,它们恰恰会放大二阶分析本就要 检测的小距离聚集。
因此构建三种分析单元,且每一项二阶结果都对三者分别报告。



Code
tibble::tibble(
  Unit = c("**Detection**", "**Pixel-day** *(primary)*", "**Event**"),
  Definition = c(
    "Every retained record: one 375 m pixel in one overpass.",
    "One point per unique 375 m grid cell per **local** calendar day; among duplicates the highest-FRP record is kept.",
    "Single-linkage cluster of pixel-days within 750 m *and* 1 day of one another, reduced to its centroid."),
  n = c(N_DET, N_PX, N_EV),
  Removes = c(
    "nothing",
    "same-day repeat overpasses of one pixel",
    "spatial extent and multi-day persistence of one burning area"),
  Interprets_as = c(
    "detection intensity, closest to the raw observation",
    "daily fire-affected pixel, the compromise used throughout",
    "approximate distinct fire event, i.e. nearest to *ignitions*")
) |>
  gt::gt() |>
  gt::cols_label(Interprets_as = "Interpreted as") |>
  gt::fmt_markdown(columns = c(Unit)) |>
  gt::fmt_number(columns = n, decimals = 0) |>
  gt::tab_options(table.font.size = gt::pct(84),
                  data_row.padding = gt::px(6))

Table 2: The three analysis units. The pixel-day unit is used for all headline results.三种分析单元。所有主要结果均采用「像元-日」单元。





The pixel-day unit is primary because it removes the duplication that is purely instrumental (repeat overpasses) without discarding the duplication that is substantively meaningful (a pixel that burns on several successive days is genuinely burning on several successive days). The event unit is the most appealing conceptually, but § 6.5 shows that at this fire density single-linkage chaining merges much of the landscape into one component, so it is used for robustness rather than for headline results.


之所以以「像元-日」为主单元,是因为它剔除了纯属仪器性的重复(重复过境),同时 保留了实质上有意义的重复(某像元连续几天燃烧,就是真的连续几天在烧)。「事件」 单元在概念上最有吸引力,但 § 6.5 表明:在本例的火密度下,单连接 链式合并会把大片景观并成一个连通分量,因此该单元仅用于稳健性检验,而非主要结果。

title: Take-home Exercise 1: Fire on Drained Peat课后作业一：排水泥炭地上的火
section: 2.4 Spatial study window空间研究窗口
text:
2.4 Spatial study window空间研究窗口

The window is Pulang Pisau Regency as delineated in the official COD-AB ADM2 layer (Badan Pusat Statistik & United Nations OCHA Regional Office for Asia and the Pacific, 2026), projected to EPSG:32749.


研究窗口为官方 COD-AB ADM2 图层 (Badan Pusat Statistik & United Nations OCHA Regional Office for Asia and the Pacific, 2026) 界定的 Pulang Pisau 县, 投影至 EPSG:32749。


Three choices need defending.
Why an administrative boundary at all? A point process must be analysed inside a window that is defined independently of the points; otherwise edge effects and intensity estimates are conditioned on the data. Candidate windows were a regency boundary, a peat-hydrological unit, and a convex or concave hull of the detections. The hull is disqualified outright. It is defined by the data. A hydrological unit would be scientifically preferable, since the process is hydrological, but it does not correspond to any administrative mandate. The regency is chosen because it is the unit that owns the response: fire suppression, land-use permitting and village-level prevention budgets are administered at regency and kecamatan level, so findings expressed on this window are directly actionable. The cost is that the boundary is arbitrary with respect to the fire process, and § 6.5 tests the consequence.


有三项选择需要论证。
为什么要用行政边界? 点过程必须在一个独立于点本身定义的窗口内分析,否则 边界效应与强度估计都会被数据所条件化。候选窗口有三种:县界、泥炭水文单元,以及 探测点的凸包/凹包。凸包直接被排除。它是由数据定义的。水文单元在科学上更可取 (该过程本身就是水文性的),但它不对应任何行政职责。最终选择县界,因为它是 承担应对责任的单元:灭火、土地利用许可与村级预防预算都在县与区(kecamatan) 层级管理,因此在这一窗口上表述的发现可以直接落地。代价是该边界相对于火灾过程是 任意的,§ 6.5 检验了这一代价的后果。


Why the official COD-AB layer? It is sourced from Badan Pusat Statistik and carries a stated validity date (boundaries valid from 1 April 2020), a version, and kecamatan-level nesting. The independently produced geoBoundaries ADM2 polygon for the same regency gives an area of 9758.9 km² against 9758.9 km² here (a difference of 0.00%), which is reassuring, and unsurprising, since both ultimately derive from the same BPS geometry.
What is the window’s actual extent? The polygon is a single part, topologically valid, with 4,179 vertices. Its area is 9,759 km², closely matching the area_sqkm attribute carried in the source file (9741 km²). It is strongly elongated: 86 km east–west by 213 km north–south. This matters twice over: it caps the distance at which second-order functions can be estimated (§ 6.1), and it makes a single isotropic kernel bandwidth a stronger assumption than it would be in a compact window (§ 5.3). The southern boundary is a coast, so part of the perimeter borders water rather than land, a further source of edge effect that no edge correction models, because those corrections assume the process continues beyond the boundary.


为什么用官方 COD-AB 图层? 它源自印尼中央统计局(Badan Pusat Statistik), 带有明确生效日期(边界自 2020 年 4 月 1 日起有效)、版本号,以及区级嵌套结构。 独立制作的 geoBoundaries ADM2 多边形对同一个县给出面积 9758.9 km²,本研究为 9758.9 km², 差异 0.00%。这既令人放心 也不意外,因为两者最终都源自同一套 BPS 几何。
这个窗口的实际范围是什么? 该多边形为单一部件、拓扑有效,共 4,179 个顶点。面积 9,759 km²,与源文件所带 area_sqkm 属性 (9741 km²)高度一致。其形状高度狭长:东西向 86 km,南北向 213 km。这有双重影响:它限制了二阶函数 可被估计的最大距离(§ 6.1),也使「单一各向同性核带宽」这一假设比在 紧凑窗口中更强(§ 5.3)。南界为海岸线,因此部分周长临水而非临陆 。这是又一处边界效应来源,而任何边界校正都无法建模它,因为那些校正都假定过程在 边界之外继续存在。

title: Take-home Exercise 1: Fire on Drained Peat课后作业一：排水泥炭地上的火
section: 2.5 Temporal study window时间研究窗口
text:
2.5 Temporal study window时间研究窗口

The analysis covers 04 September to 11 September 2026 (8 local days), which is the full extent of the open FIRMS archive at the time of access.
This is a short window, and honesty about what it can support matters more than apparent sophistication:

It falls in the peak of the Central Kalimantan dry season, so it captures the hazard at its most intense, not as an annual average. Conclusions describe a burning episode, not a fire year.
No seasonality can be estimated. Questions about monthly or inter-annual variation are outside the reach of these data, and are not asked.
Temporal aggregation is to the local calendar day. Finer aggregation is impossible: as § 5.1 shows, S-NPP contributes detections at only about two local times per day, so anything finer than a day would describe the satellite’s orbit rather than the fire’s behaviour.
Eight days is enough for a space-time interaction test at lags of 0–5 days (§ 6.6), which is the relevant scale for fire spread and for day-to-day ignition decisions, but not for anything longer.

The authenticated acquisition script is included precisely so that this limitation is removable: supplying a FIRMS MAP_KEY and rerunning scripts/01_download_firms.R with a wider date range reproduces every result below over a full season, with no change to any other file.


分析覆盖 2026-09-04 至 2026-09-11,共 8 个当地日,即访问时开放 FIRMS 档案的全部范围。
这是一个很短的窗口,而诚实说明它能支持什么,比表面上的复杂度更重要:

它正落在中加里曼丹旱季峰值,因此捕捉到的是灾害最强烈的状态,而非年度平均。 结论描述的是一次燃烧事件,不是一个火年。
无法估计季节性。 月际或年际变化的问题超出本数据能力范围,故本报告不提出。
时间聚合到当地日历日。更细的聚合不可能:如 § 5.1 所示,S-NPP 每天只在约两个当地时刻贡献探测,因此任何比「日」更细的粒度描述的都是卫星轨道, 而不是火的行为。
八天足以支持滞后 0–5 天的时空交互检验(§ 6.6),这正是火蔓延与逐日点火 决策的相关尺度;但不足以支持更长尺度的分析。

之所以把需认证的获取脚本一并纳入,正是为了让这一局限可以被移除:提供 FIRMS MAP_KEY 并以更宽日期范围重跑 scripts/01_download_firms.R,即可在整个火季上 复现下文全部结果,其余文件一行都不需要改。

title: Take-home Exercise 1: Fire on Drained Peat课后作业一：排水泥炭地上的火
section: 3.1 Import and schema harmonisation数据导入与模式统一
text:
3.1 Import and schema harmonisation数据导入与模式统一

Every column is read as character first. This is deliberate: if readr guessed a numeric type it would coerce a malformed coordinate to NA during parsing, and the record would be lost before it could be counted as a data fault. Numeric coercion happens afterwards, under our own control.
The four products do not share a schema. VIIRS reports channel brightness temperatures as bright_ti4 (4 µm) and bright_ti5 (11 µm); MODIS reports brightness and bright_t31. Confidence is a three-level ordinal class for VIIRS (low/nominal/high), but an integer percentage 0–100 for MODIS. These are mapped onto common fields (bt_fire, bt_bg, confidence_cls), so that one filtering rule can be stated, while firms_source preserves the provenance of every row.


所有列先一律按 character 读入。这是刻意的:如果让 readr 猜测数值类型,它会在 解析阶段就把格式错误的坐标强制转成 NA,该记录在能被计为一个数据缺陷之前就已经 丢失了。数值转换在此之后、由我们自己控制地进行。
四种产品的数据模式并不一致。VIIRS 用 bright_ti4(4 µm)和 bright_ti5(11 µm) 报告通道亮温;MODIS 用 brightness 和 bright_t31。置信度在 VIIRS 中是三级有序 分类(low/nominal/high),在 MODIS 中却是 0–100 的整数百分比。这些字段被 映射到统一字段(bt_fire、bt_bg、confidence_cls),以便用一条筛选规则表述; 同时 firms_source 保留每一行的来源出处。



Confidence harmonisation rule
fires |> mutate(confidence_cls = case_when(
  sensor_family == "VIIRS" & str_starts(str_to_lower(confidence_raw), "l") ~ "low",
  sensor_family == "VIIRS" & str_starts(str_to_lower(confidence_raw), "n") ~ "nominal",
  sensor_family == "VIIRS" & str_starts(str_to_lower(confidence_raw), "h") ~ "high",
  sensor_family == "MODIS" & conf_num <  30 ~ "low",      # MODIS 0-100 scale
  sensor_family == "MODIS" & conf_num <  80 ~ "nominal",
  sensor_family == "MODIS" & conf_num >= 80 ~ "high"))

objectID: take-home-ex/take-home-ex1/take-home-ex1.html#coordinates-validity-and-a-precision-trap坐标有效性以及一个精度陷阱
href: take-home-ex/take-home-ex1/take-home-ex1.html#coordinates-validity-and-a-precision-trap坐标有效性以及一个精度陷阱
title: Take-home Exercise 1: Fire on Drained Peat课后作业一：排水泥炭地上的火
section: 3.2 Coordinates: validity, and a precision trap坐标:有效性,以及一个精度陷阱
text:
3.2 Coordinates: validity, and a precision trap坐标:有效性,以及一个精度陷阱

No record had a missing or non-numeric coordinate, and none fell outside valid geographic ranges or on the (0, 0) null island, checks that cost nothing and would have been serious if they had fired.
There is, however, a subtler issue. Latitudes are written with between one and five decimal places:


没有任何记录出现坐标缺失或非数值的情况,也没有任何记录落在有效地理范围之外或 (0, 0) 这个「空岛」上。这些检查成本为零,但一旦触发就会很严重。
不过存在一个更微妙的问题。纬度的小数位数在一位到五位之间不等:



Code
raw_chk <- readr::read_csv(
  list.files("data/raw", "^firms_pulangpisau_.*[.]csv$", full.names = TRUE)[1],
  show_col_types = FALSE, col_types = readr::cols(.default = readr::col_character()))
tibble(dp = nchar(stringr::str_replace(raw_chk$latitude, "^[^.]*[.]?", ""))) |>
  count(dp, name = "records") |>
  mutate(`implied precision` = scales::label_comma(accuracy = 0.01)(111320 / 10^dp),
         `implied precision` = paste0(`implied precision`, " m")) |>
  gt::gt() |> gt::cols_label(dp = "Decimal places") |>
  gt::tab_options(table.font.size = gt::pct(85), data_row.padding = gt::px(4))











Decimal places
records
implied precision




1
2
11,132.00 m


2

Table 3: Decimal places in the latitude field as delivered. The variation is an artefact of dropped trailing zeros, not of varying measurement precision.交付数据中纬度字段的小数位数。这种差异是末尾零被省略造成的假象,而不是测量精度本身在变化。





Five decimal places implies roughly metre precision, which is spurious. The reported coordinate is the centre of a 375 m nominal pixel, and the pixel grows towards the swath edge, the scan and track fields in these data reach 0.80 and 0.78 km respectively. The effective location uncertainty of a point in this pattern is therefore of order a few hundred metres, not metres.


五位小数意味着约米级精度,而这是虚假的。所报告的坐标是一个 375 m 标称像元的 中心,而像元尺寸向扫描边缘增大,本数据中 scan 与 track 字段分别达到 0.80 与 0.78 km。因此本模式中一个点的有效定位不确定度是数百米量级,而不是米级。







ImportantThe consequence for second-order analysis



Because location uncertainty is of order 375 m, no second-order result below about 400–500 m can be interpreted as a property of fire. Structure at those distances is a property of the sensor’s pixel grid. This bound is used in § 5.3 to reject two of the four automatic bandwidth selectors, and it is the reason all pair-correlation interpretation in § 6.4 starts above 500 m.








Important这对二阶分析的后果



由于定位不确定度为 375 m 量级,任何低于约 400–500 m 的二阶结果都不能被解释为火的 性质。这些距离上的结构是传感器像元格网的性质。这一下界被用于 § 5.3 中否决四个自动带宽选择器中的两个,也是 § 6.4 中所有对相关函数的解读都从 500 m 以上开始的原因。

title: Take-home Exercise 1: Fire on Drained Peat课后作业一：排水泥炭地上的火
section: 3.3 Timestamps: the local-time correction时间戳:本地时校正
text:
3.3 Timestamps: the local-time correction时间戳:本地时校正

FIRMS reports acq_date and acq_time in UTC. Central Kalimantan observes Waktu Indonesia Barat (WIB), UTC+07. The S-NPP night overpass occurs at roughly 01:30 local time, which is 18:30 UTC on the previous calendar day.
Deriving a fire’s “day” from the UTC date would therefore assign every night detection to the wrong day. The effect is not marginal:


FIRMS 以 UTC 报告 acq_date 与 acq_time。中加里曼丹使用西印尼时间 (Waktu Indonesia Barat, WIB),即 UTC+07。S-NPP 的夜间过境约在当地时间 01:30, 也就是前一个日历日的 UTC 18:30。
因此,若用 UTC 日期推导一场火的「日期」,就会把每一个夜间探测都归到错误的日子。 这个影响并不轻微:



Code
fire_sf |> sf::st_drop_geometry() |>
  count(Overpass = overpass, `Local date differs from UTC date` = day_shifted) |>
  tidyr::pivot_wider(names_from = `Local date differs from UTC date`,
                     values_from = n, values_fill = 0L,
                     names_prefix = "shifted_") |>
  gt::gt() |>
  gt::cols_label(shifted_FALSE = "Same date", shifted_TRUE = "Shifted by one day") |>
  gt::tab_options(table.font.size = gt::pct(85), data_row.padding = gt::px(4))











Overpass
Same date
Shifted by one day




Day
1495
0


Night
0
1606








Table 4: Records whose local calendar date differs from the UTC calendar date, by overpass.本地日历日期与 UTC 日历日期不一致的记录数,按过境类型划分。





1,606 of 3,101 detections (52%) (precisely the night overpasses) change date under the correction. Every temporal variable in this report is built from the local timestamp.
A second fact emerges from the same conversion, and it constrains the whole temporal analysis:


3,101 条探测中有 1,606 条 (52%)(恰好就是夜间过境)在 校正后改变了日期。此后每一个时间变量都基于本地时间戳构建。
同一次时区转换还揭示出第二个事实,它约束了整个时间分析:



Code
fire_sf |> sf::st_drop_geometry() |>
  ggplot(aes(hour_local, fill = overpass)) +
  geom_histogram(binwidth = 1/6, colour = NA) +
  scale_fill_manual(NULL, values = c(Day = PAL$fire_l, Night = PAL$water)) +
  scale_x_continuous(breaks = seq(0, 24, 3), limits = c(0, 24),
                     labels = function(x) sprintf("%02d:00", x)) +
  labs(title = "S-NPP samples this landscape twice a day, not continuously",
       subtitle = paste0("All ", n_fmt(N_DET),
                         " retained detections, local time (WIB, UTC+07)"),
       x = "Local time of acquisition", y = "Detections",
       caption = "Day overpass 12:08-13:54; night overpass 00:11-01:51 local.") +
  theme_th()








Figure 2: Local acquisition time of every S-NPP detection. Detections arrive in two narrow windows because that is when the satellite passes, so nothing finer than a daily aggregation can describe fire rather than orbit.每个 S-NPP 探测点的本地获取时刻。探测集中在两个狭窄的时间窗内,因为那就是卫星过境的时刻;因此任何比「日」更细的聚合描述的都是轨道而不是火。






Two overpasses, not a day. The distribution is bimodal with empty gaps covering about 21 of 24 hours. This is the satellite’s orbit, not the fire’s diurnal cycle: S-NPP crosses the equator at about 13:30 and 01:30 local. Two consequences follow. First, any diurnal question (when in the day do fires start, peak, or die down) is unanswerable with these data, and is not asked. Second, a fire that ignites and burns out between overpasses is invisible, so the pattern systematically under-represents short-lived fires. This is a first-order bias in the observation process, not random noise. A caveat: the within-window spread (about 1.8 h) reflects orbital drift across the eight days, not variation in when fires burn.


两次过境,不是一整天。 分布呈双峰,空白区间覆盖了 24 小时中的约 21 小时。这是卫星的 轨道,而不是火的日变化周期:S-NPP 约在当地 13:30 与 01:30 过赤道。由此有两个 后果。 第一,任何日变化问题(火在一天中何时开始、何时最盛、何时熄灭)用这些 数据都无法回答,因此不予讨论。第二,在两次过境之间点燃并烧完的火是不可见的, 因此本模式系统性地低估了短时火。这是观测过程中的一阶偏差,不是随机噪声。 一点保留: 窗口内约 1.8 小时的时刻散布反映的是八天间的轨道漂移,而不是火燃烧时刻的 变化。

title: Take-home Exercise 1: Fire on Drained Peat课后作业一：排水泥炭地上的火
section: 3.4 Confidence, and what “high confidence” actually means置信度,以及「高置信度」的真实含义
text:
3.4 Confidence, and what “high confidence” actually means置信度,以及「高置信度」的真实含义

Low-confidence VIIRS detections carry an elevated false-alarm rate (Schroeder et al., 2014) and are removed: 697 records (3.6%) across all four products.
Inspecting the retained classes produced an unexpected and important result.


低置信度的 VIIRS 探测具有偏高的误报率 (Schroeder et al., 2014),已被剔除:四种产品合计 697 条 (3.6%)。
而检视被保留的各等级时,得到了一个出乎意料且重要的结果。



Code
fire_sf |> sf::st_drop_geometry() |>
  mutate(`I-04 saturated (>= 367 K)` = bt_fire >= 367) |>
  count(`Confidence class` = confidence_cls, `I-04 saturated (>= 367 K)`) |>
  tidyr::pivot_wider(names_from = `I-04 saturated (>= 367 K)`, values_from = n,
                     values_fill = 0L, names_prefix = "sat_") |>
  gt::gt() |>
  gt::cols_label(sat_FALSE = "Below saturation", sat_TRUE = "At 367 K ceiling") |>
  gt::tab_options(table.font.size = gt::pct(85), data_row.padding = gt::px(4))











Confidence class
Below saturation
At 367 K ceiling




nominal
2998
0


high
0
103








Table 5: Confidence class against I-04 channel saturation for S-NPP detections inside the study window. The correspondence is exact.研究窗口内 S-NPP 探测的置信度等级与 I-04 通道饱和情况的交叉表。两者完全一一对应。





Every one of the 103 “high” confidence detections sits exactly at 367.0 K, the I-04 channel saturation limit, and no “nominal” detection does. So in this product “high confidence” is a statement about fire intensity, not about locational reliability. It flags pixels so hot that the 4 µm channel saturated. Two things follow. First, confidence must not be used as a weight for location accuracy. Second, the fire radiative power reported for those 103 records is derived from a saturated radiance and is a lower bound; FRP is consequently used only descriptively in this report, never as an analytical weight.


全部 103 条「高」置信度 探测的亮温都恰好落在 367.0 K,即 I-04 通道的 饱和上限,而没有任何一条「nominal」探测落在该值。因此在本产品中,「高置信度」 陈述的是火的强度,而不是定位可靠性。它标记的是热到让 4 µm 通道饱和的像元。 由此有两点推论。第一,置信度不可用作定位精度的权重。第二,这 103 条记录所报告的火辐射功率 是由已饱和的辐亮度推导的,只是一个下界;因此 FRP 在全篇仅作描述性使用, 从不作为分析权重。

title: Take-home Exercise 1: Fire on Drained Peat课后作业一：排水泥炭地上的火
section: 3.5 Static heat sources and the missing type flag静态热源与缺失的 type 标记
text:
3.5 Static heat sources and the missing type flag静态热源与缺失的 type 标记

The FIRMS Standard Processing products carry a type flag distinguishing presumed vegetation fire (0) from active volcano (1), other static land source (2) and offshore (3). The open 7-day NRT files omit it, so the filter cannot be applied. Rather than ignore the gap, an empirical substitute is used: a persistent industrial source such as a gas flare should be detected on essentially every cloud-free overpass, so it would appear as a pixel recurring on nearly all days.


FIRMS 标准处理产品带有一个 type 标记,用于区分推定植被火(0)、活火山(1)、 其他静态陆地热源(2)与离岸(3)。开放的 7 日 NRT 文件不含该标记,因此这道 筛选无法应用。与其忽略这一缺口,这里采用一个经验替代:像气体火炬这类持续性工业 热源,在几乎每一次无云过境时都应被探测到,因此它会表现为一个几乎每天都复现的 像元。



Code
persist |> count(n_days) |>
  ggplot(aes(factor(n_days), n)) +
  geom_col(fill = PAL$fire_l, width = 0.72) +
  geom_text(aes(label = n_fmt(n)), vjust = -0.4, size = 3.1, colour = PAL$grey) +
  scale_y_continuous(expand = expansion(mult = c(0, 0.13))) +
  labs(title = "No candidate static heat source",
       subtitle = paste0(n_fmt(nrow(persist)),
                         " distinct 375 m pixels detected at least once in ",
                         N_DAYS, " days"),
       x = "Number of distinct local days on which the pixel was detected",
       y = "Pixels",
       caption = paste0("A gas flare or similar static source would be expected near ",
                        N_DAYS, " days. The maximum observed is ",
                        max(persist$n_days), ".")) +
  theme_th()








Figure 3: How many distinct local days each 375 m pixel was detected on. No pixel recurs on more than six of the eight days, and the decay is smooth, the signature expected of spreading and smouldering fire, not of a static industrial source.每个 375 m 像元被探测到的不同本地日数。没有像元在八天中出现超过六天,且衰减平滑。这是蔓延与阴燃火所应有的特征,而非静态工业热源的特征。






1,267 of 1,818 pixels (70%) were detected on a single day, and the maximum is 6 of 8. There is no evidence of a static source in this window, so the inability to apply the type filter is judged not to bias the results. This is an empirical argument, not a guarantee: a flare obscured by cloud on several days would be missed, and the authenticated acquisition route (which returns the flag) would settle the question.


1,818 个像元中有 1,267 个 (70%)只在一天被探测到, 最大值为 8 天中的 6 天。本窗口内没有静态热源的证据, 因此判定无法应用 type 筛选不会使结果产生偏差。这是一个经验性论证,而非保证: 若某个火炬在若干天被云遮挡,就会被漏掉;而需认证的获取路径(会返回该标记)可以 彻底解决这个问题。

Table 6: Coincident-point diagnostics for the three analysis units. Several spatstat summary functions assume a simple point pattern; the result is reported rather than left inside a warning.三种分析单元的重合点诊断。若干 spatstat 汇总函数假定点模式为简单点模式;此处明确报告结果,而不是把它留在一条警告信息里。





Exact duplicate records (identical product, coordinate and timestamp) numbered 0. More interesting is that no two detections share an exact coordinate, because the pixel centre shifts slightly between overpasses as the scan geometry changes. The repeats are therefore invisible to a naive duplicate check and must be found by snapping to a grid:


完全重复的记录(产品、坐标与时间戳三者全同)共 0 条。更值得注意的是, 没有任何两条探测共享完全相同的坐标,因为随着扫描几何变化,像元中心在不同过境 之间会有微小偏移。因此这些重复对朴素的去重检查是不可见的,必须通过对齐到格网 才能找出:



Code
xy <- sf::st_coordinates(fire_all_sf)
fire_all_sf <- fire_all_sf |>
  mutate(gx = floor(xy[, 1] / P$pixel_grid_m),     # P$pixel_grid_m = 375
         gy = floor(xy[, 2] / P$pixel_grid_m),
         pixel_id = paste(gx, gy, sep = "_"))



Collapsing to one point per pixel per local day removes 386 records (12.4%), same-day repeat overpasses of the same ground pixel.


折叠为「每像元每本地日一个点」后移除了 386 条记录 (12.4%),即同一地面像元在同一天的重复 过境。

section: 3.7 How much of this pattern is the satellite?这个模式里有多少是卫星造成的?
text:
3.7 How much of this pattern is the satellite?这个模式里有多少是卫星造成的?

Three near-identical VIIRS instruments flew over this window in the same eight days. If detection were a faithful census of burning, they would largely agree.


在同样的八天里,有三台近乎相同的 VIIRS 仪器飞越本窗口。如果探测是对燃烧的忠实 普查,它们本应大体一致。



Code
agree <- fire_all |> sf::st_drop_geometry() |>
  dplyr::filter(grepl("VIIRS", firms_source)) |>
  distinct(pixel_id, date_local, firms_source) |>
  count(pixel_id, date_local, name = "n_products")

p1 <- agree |> count(n_products) |>
  mutate(pct = 100 * n / sum(n)) |>
  ggplot(aes(factor(n_products), n)) +
  geom_col(fill = PAL$water, width = 0.68) +
  geom_text(aes(label = sprintf("%s\n(%.0f%%)", n_fmt(n), pct)),
            vjust = -0.25, size = 3, lineheight = 0.9, colour = PAL$grey) +
  scale_y_continuous(expand = expansion(mult = c(0, 0.22))) +
  labs(title = "Most burning pixel-days are seen by only one of three satellites",
       x = "Number of VIIRS products detecting the pixel-day",
       y = "Pixel-days") +
  theme_th(11)

p2 <- FO_T$daily_sensor |>
  tidyr::pivot_longer(-date_local, names_to = "product", values_to = "n") |>
  mutate(product = stringr::str_replace(product, "_NRT", "")) |>
  ggplot(aes(date_local, n, colour = product)) +
  geom_line(linewidth = 0.75) + geom_point(size = 1.5) +
  scale_colour_manual(NULL, values = c(VIIRS_SNPP = PAL$fire,
                                       VIIRS_NOAA20 = PAL$fire_l,
                                       VIIRS_NOAA21 = PAL$water,
                                       MODIS = PAL$grey)) +
  scale_x_date(date_labels = "%d %b") +
  labs(title = "Daily counts disagree between near-identical sensors",
       x = NULL, y = "Detections in window") +
  theme_th(11)

p1 + p2 + patchwork::plot_layout(widths = c(1, 1.15))








Figure 4: Agreement between the three VIIRS products. Left: how many of the three detected each fire-affected pixel-day. Right: daily detection counts by product, showing that day-to-day swings are not shared.三种 VIIRS 产品之间的一致性。左:每个过火像元-日被其中几种产品探测到。右:各产品的逐日探测数,显示逐日波动并不共享。






Where the sensors disagree. Only 8.8% of fire-affected pixel-days were detected by all three VIIRS satellites, while 63% were seen by just one. The right panel shows the consequence: on 8 September, NOAA-20 recorded 17 detections while NOAA-21 recorded 329 over the same ground on the same day. Evidence: the instruments are functionally identical, so the disagreement must come from overpass timing, view geometry and, above all, cloud. Implication: detection is a heavily sub-sampled view of the fire field, so day-to-day count variation cannot be read as fire-activity variation, and absolute intensities are lower bounds throughout. Worth noting: the three satellites’ orbits differ, so some genuine disagreement is expected even with perfect instruments.


传感器分歧出现在哪里。 过火像元-日中只有 8.8% 被三颗 VIIRS 卫星全部探测到, 而 63% 只被其中一颗看到。右图 显示了后果:9 月 8 日,NOAA-20 记录了 17 条探测,而 NOAA-21 在同一天、同一片地面上记录了 329 条。证据: 这些仪器在功能上是相同的,因此分歧必然来自过境时刻、观测几何, 以及最主要的云层遮挡。含义: 探测是对火场的严重欠采样视图,因此逐日计数 变化不能被读作火灾活动的变化,而全篇的绝对强度都只是下界。需注意: 三颗卫星轨道 不同,因此即使仪器完美也会有一部分真实分歧。

text:
3.8 Projection and spatial filtering投影与空间筛选

Coordinates are transformed from EPSG:4326 to EPSG:32749 (WGS 84 / UTM zone 49S). The reasons, and the alternatives rejected:


坐标由 EPSG:4326 转换为 EPSG:32749(WGS 84 / UTM 49S 带)。理由,以及被 否决的替代方案如下(下表为英文原表):









Requirement
Why
Outcome




Metre units
spatstat requires planar coordinates; bandwidths, distances and areas must be in a physical unit
Rules out any geographic CRS


Low area distortion
Intensity is events per unit area, so area error propagates directly into every density estimate
UTM 49S gives 9,759 km² against 9,784 km² measured geodesically on the WGS84 ellipsoid, an error of 0.26%


Conformality
Isotropic kernels and isotropic distance functions assume distance means the same thing in all directions
Transverse Mercator is conformal; an equal-area projection would not be


Local suitability
The regency spans 113.58–114.35 °E
Mostly within UTM zone 49 (108–114 °E); the eastern sliver crossing 114 °E is the source of the residual distortion above




DGN95 / Indonesia TM-3 was considered, since it is the national system, but its 1.5°-wide zones place this regency awkwardly and it offers no practical advantage here over UTM 49S at this level of distortion.
Points are then clipped to the window, removing 9,698 detections that fell in the buffered download box but outside the regency. Downloading a buffered box and clipping afterwards (rather than requesting the exact polygon) keeps the boundary decision in the analysis, where it is documented and testable, instead of in the acquisition step.


曾考虑 DGN95 / Indonesia TM-3(印尼国家坐标系),但其 1.5° 宽的分带使本县位置 尴尬,且在当前畸变水平下相对 UTM 49S 没有实际优势。
随后将点裁剪到窗口内,移除了 9,698 条落在缓冲下载框内但在县界之外 的探测。先下载缓冲框、事后裁剪(而不是直接请求精确多边形),是为了把边界决策留在 分析环节(在那里它有文档、可检验)而不是埋进数据获取环节。

title: Take-home Exercise 1: Fire on Drained Peat课后作业一：排水泥炭地上的火
section: 4.1 The foundational assumption, and how it fails最基础的那个假设,以及它如何失效
text:
4.1 The foundational assumption, and how it fails最基础的那个假设,以及它如何失效

Every method below treats the data as a realisation of a point process \(X\) on the window \(W\), observed completely. Three parts of that need scrutiny.
Events are points. They are not; they are 375 m pixels, represented by their centres. The approximation is harmless for questions posed at kilometre scales and invalid below about 500 m (§ 3). Every interpretation below respects that floor.
The window is fixed and independent of the data. Satisfied: the regency boundary was fixed before the points were seen. This is why a convex or concave hull of the detections was rejected as a window in § 2.4.
Observation is complete. This fails. § 3.7 showed that only 8.8% of fire-affected pixel-days were seen by all three VIIRS satellites, and § 5.1 shows one day in the series with no daytime detections at all. Formally, what is observed is a thinned version of the fire process, with retention probability \(p(u, t)\) that depends on cloud, overpass geometry and fire size.


下文所有方法都把数据视为窗口 \(W\) 上某个点过程 \(X\) 的一次完整观测的实现。 其中有三个部分需要审视。
事件是点。 它们不是;它们是 375 m 像元,用其中心代表。这一近似对公里尺度的 问题无害,但在约 500 m 以下无效(§ 3)。下文每一处解读都遵守这一下界。
窗口是固定的,且独立于数据。 满足:县界在看到点之前就已固定。这正是 § 2.4 中把探测点的凸包/凹包排除在窗口候选之外的原因。
观测是完整的。 这一条失效。 § 3.7 表明,过火像元-日中只有 8.8% 被三颗 VIIRS 卫星全部看到,而 § 5.1 显示序列中有一天完全没有白天探测。 形式化地说,我们观测到的是火灾过程的一个抽稀(thinned)版本,其保留概率 \(p(u, t)\) 取决于云、过境几何与火的规模。







ImportantWhat thinning does (and does not) do to the conclusions



Independent random thinning leaves the inhomogeneous second-order structure unchanged: if \(X\) has pair correlation \(g(r)\), a thinned version has the same \(g(r)\) (A. Baddeley et al., 2015, ch. 7). That is a genuinely useful robustness property, and it is why the second-order conclusions in § 6 survive an incomplete observation process.
Thinning is not independent here, though. Cloud is spatially and temporally autocorrelated over tens of kilometres and whole days. Two specific consequences follow, and both are carried into the interpretation:

First-order intensities are lower bounds, and the ratio between high and low intensity areas is biased if cloud frequency differs between them.
Day-to-day count variation is not fire-activity variation, which is why § 5.1 reports the temporal analysis as being about the observation-fire compound rather than about fire.









Important抽稀会、以及不会对结论造成什么影响



独立随机抽稀不改变非齐次二阶结构:若 \(X\) 的对相关函数为 \(g(r)\),其抽稀版本 具有相同的 \(g(r)\) (A. Baddeley et al., 2015, ch. 7)。这是一条确实有用的稳健性性质,也正是 § 6 中二阶结论能在不完整观测下依然成立的原因。
然而此处的抽稀并非独立。云在数十公里、整天的尺度上具有空间与时间自相关。 由此有两个具体后果,二者都被带入了解读:

一阶强度只是下界,而且如果高强度区与低强度区的云频率不同,两者之间的强度 比值也会有偏。
逐日计数变化不等于火灾活动变化。这正是 § 5.1 把时间分析表述为 关于观测, 火复合体而不是关于火本身的原因。

section: 4.2 Assumptions by method各方法所需的假设
text:
4.2 Assumptions by method各方法所需的假设


Code
tibble::tribble(
  ~Method, ~Assumption, ~Holds, ~`Consequence and mitigation`,

  "Quadrat $\\chi^2$ test", "Homogeneous Poisson process (constant intensity, independent points)",
  "**No**",
  "Rejection is uninformative: it cannot distinguish intensity variation from interaction. Reported only to demonstrate that fact, across four quadrat sizes.",

  "Fixed-bandwidth KDE", "A single bandwidth is appropriate everywhere; kernel is isotropic",
  "**Partly**",
  "Intensity spans two orders of magnitude, so one bandwidth must oversmooth peaks or undersmooth sparse areas. Mitigated with a bandwidth ladder and an adaptive-bandwidth estimate.",

  "KDE edge correction", "The process continues beyond $W$ in the same way",
  "**Partly**",
  "True on land borders, false on the southern coast, where there is no process beyond the boundary. Coastal intensities are therefore over-corrected upward.",

  "$G$, $F$, $J$ functions", "Stationarity and isotropy",
  "**No**",
  "Under strong inhomogeneity these functions confound intensity variation with interaction. Used descriptively; no interaction claim rests on them.",

  "Ripley's $K$ vs CSR", "Stationarity and isotropy",
  "**No**",
  "Guaranteed rejection. Included as an explicit demonstration of why an inhomogeneous null is required.",

  "$K_{inhom}$, $g_{inhom}$", "**Scale separation**: intensity varies only at scales $\\ge \\sigma_\\lambda$; interaction operates below it",
  "*Unverifiable*",
  "The central assumption of this report. Cannot be checked from one realisation, so results are reported across $\\sigma_\\lambda \\in \\{1, 2, 5, 10\\}$ km and the conclusion is stated as a function of it (@sec-so-kinhom).",

  "$K_{inhom}$ intensity estimate", "$\\hat\\lambda$ is not contaminated by the pattern it describes",
  "**Partly**",
  "Leave-one-out kernel estimation and `normpower = 2` reduce, but do not remove, the bias. Direction of bias is towards the null, so a positive finding is conservative.",

  "Isotropy of interaction", "Interaction depends on distance, not direction",
  "**Doubtful**",
  "Canals form an oriented grid, so fire may spread preferentially along them. An isotropic $g(r)$ would then understate the true along-canal correlation. Flagged as a limitation, not resolved.",

  "Knox space-time test", "Under the null, dates are exchangeable across locations",
  "**Yes, by construction**",
  "This is the strength of the test: it requires no model for either the spatial or the temporal marginal pattern. The cost is that 'interaction' here includes first-order space-time inseparability (a moving fire front), not only contagion.",

  "`ppm` (Poisson pseudolikelihood)", "Conditional independence of points given the trend",
  "**No**",
  "Point estimates of the trend remain consistent, but standard errors are **understated**, possibly severely. Coefficients are therefore interpreted for sign and magnitude, and the clustering is modelled explicitly in `kppm`.",

  "Thomas cluster process", "Parents are a homogeneous Poisson process; offspring are isotropic Gaussian scatter",
  "**Approximately**",
  "Anisotropic, canal-aligned spread violates the isotropic-offspring assumption, so the fitted `scale` should be read as an effective cluster radius rather than a physical one."
) |>
  gt::gt() |>
  gt::fmt_markdown(columns = c(Assumption, Holds, `Consequence and mitigation`)) |>
  gt::cols_width(Method ~ gt::pct(16), Assumption ~ gt::pct(25),
                 Holds ~ gt::pct(9), `Consequence and mitigation` ~ gt::pct(50)) |>
  gt::tab_options(table.font.size = gt::pct(78), data_row.padding = gt::px(6))

















Method
Assumption
Holds
Consequence and mitigation




Quadrat $\chi^2$ test
Homogeneous Poisson process (constant intensity, independent points)
No
Rejection is uninformative: it cannot distinguish intensity variation from interaction. Reported only to demonstrate that fact, across four quadrat sizes.


Fixed-bandwidth KDE
A single bandwidth is appropriate everywhere; kernel is isotropic
Partly
Intensity spans two orders of magnitude, so one bandwidth must oversmooth peaks or undersmooth sparse areas. Mitigated with a bandwidth ladder and an adaptive-bandwidth estimate.


KDE edge correction
The process continues beyond \(W\) in the same way
Partly
True on land borders, false on the southern coast, where there is no process beyond the boundary. Coastal intensities are therefore over-corrected upward.


$G$, $F$, $J$ functions
Stationarity and isotropy
No
Under strong inhomogeneity these functions confound intensity variation with interaction. Used descriptively; no interaction claim rests on them.


Ripley's $K$ vs CSR
Stationarity and isotropy
No
Guaranteed rejection. Included as an explicit demonstration of why an inhomogeneous null is required.


$K_{inhom}$, $g_{inhom}$
Scale separation: intensity varies only at scales \(\ge \sigma_\lambda\); interaction operates below it
Unverifiable
The central assumption of this report. Cannot be checked from one realisation, so results are reported across \(\sigma_\lambda \in \{1, 2, 5, 10\}\) km and the conclusion is stated as a function of it (§ 6.3).


$K_{inhom}$ intensity estimate
\(\hat\lambda\) is not contaminated by the pattern it describes
Partly
Leave-one-out kernel estimation and normpower = 2 reduce, but do not remove, the bias. Direction of bias is towards the null, so a positive finding is conservative.


Isotropy of interaction
Interaction depends on distance, not direction
Doubtful
Canals form an oriented grid, so fire may spread preferentially along them. An isotropic \(g(r)\) would then understate the true along-canal correlation. Flagged as a limitation, not resolved.


Knox space-time test
Under the null, dates are exchangeable across locations
Yes, by construction
This is the strength of the test: it requires no model for either the spatial or the temporal marginal pattern. The cost is that ‘interaction’ here includes first-order space-time inseparability (a moving fire front), not only contagion.


`ppm` (Poisson pseudolikelihood)
Conditional independence of points given the trend
No
Point estimates of the trend remain consistent, but standard errors are understated, possibly severely. Coefficients are therefore interpreted for sign and magnitude, and the clustering is modelled explicitly in kppm.


Thomas cluster process
Parents are a homogeneous Poisson process; offspring are isotropic Gaussian scatter
Approximately
Anisotropic, canal-aligned spread violates the isotropic-offspring assumption, so the fitted scale should be read as an effective cluster radius rather than a physical one.

Code

p_a <- daily |>
  select(date_local, Day = n_Day, Night = n_Night) |>

    name = "Detections",

       subtitle = paste0("Bars: S-NPP detections. Dashed: first detections of ",

p_b <- FO_T$daily_sensor |>
  tidyr::pivot_longer(-date_local, names_to = "product", values_to = "n") |>
  mutate(product = factor(stringr::str_replace(product, "_NRT", ""),

  geom_col(position = "dodge", width = 0.78) +

  labs(title = "The same eight days, seen by four products",
       subtitle = "Peaks and troughs do not coincide between near-identical sensors",
       x = NULL, y = "Detections in window") +
  theme_th(11)

p_a / p_b








Figure 5: Daily detection counts. Upper panel: pixel-days split by overpass, with first detections of new events overlaid. Lower panel: the same counts from all four products. The two panels together show why the upper one cannot be read as fire activity.逐日探测计数。上图:按过境类型拆分的像元-日,并叠加新事件的首次探测。下图:四种产品各自的同期计数。两图合起来说明为何上图不能被读作火灾活动。






The daily series. Counts swing from 74 to 765 pixel-days, an index of dispersion of 153 against 1 for a constant-rate Poisson process (\(\chi^2_{7} =
1072\), \(p\) < 0.001). But the variation is not attributable to fire. 4 September contributes no night detections and 7 September none by day (missing overpasses or cloud) and 7 September’s low total is exactly the day with only one overpass. The lower panel is decisive: on 8 September NOAA-20 saw 17 detections and NOAA-21 saw 329, over the same ground. Conclusion: over eight days the temporal signal is dominated by sampling, so no claim about fire trend is made. But note: a real upward movement may nevertheless be present, the 11 September peak is the highest for three of four products.


逐日序列。 计数在 74 与 765 个像元-日之间摆动,离散指数为 153,而常速率泊松过程应为 1 (\(\chi^2_{7} = 1072\), \(p\) < 0.001)。但这种变化不能归因于火。 9 月 4 日没有夜间探测, 9 月 7 日没有白天探测(过境缺失或云遮挡)而 9 月 7 日的低总量恰恰就是那个只有一次 过境的日子。下图是决定性的:9 月 8 日,NOAA-20 记录了 17 条探测,NOAA-21 在同一片地面上记录了 329 条。结论: 在这八天里,时间信号由采样主导,因此不对火灾趋势作任何论断。 但请注意: 真实的上升趋势仍有可能存在,9 月 11 日的峰值在四种产品中有三种都是最高。







WarningWhat this means for the rest of the report



Because daily counts are observation-limited, the spatio-temporal analysis below does not ask whether fire activity rose or fell. It asks two questions that survive incomplete observation: where was intensity concentrated on each day (§ 5.6), and were nearby detections close in time (§ 6.6). The second is robust to thinning by construction, because it conditions on the observed locations and dates.








Warning这对报告余下部分意味着什么



由于逐日计数受观测所限,下文的时空分析不追问火灾活动是上升还是下降。它追问的是 两个能在不完整观测下存活的问题:每一天强度集中在哪里(§ 5.6),以及 邻近的探测在时间上是否靠近(§ 6.6)。后者在构造上对抽稀稳健,因为它以 观测到的位置与日期为条件。

5.2 A coarse first look: quadrat counts粗略的第一眼:样方计数

The simplest description of spatial intensity variation divides the window into quadrats and compares counts.


对空间强度变化最简单的描述,是把窗口划分为样方并比较各方的计数。



Code
# The quadrat grid is rebuilt with sf rather than reshaped out of spatstat's
# table object: `quadrat.test` partitions the window's bounding box into nx x ny
# cells, and st_make_grid over that same bounding box reproduces the partition
# exactly while giving geometries that can be mapped and counted transparently.
grid_poly <- sf::st_make_grid(sf::st_as_sfc(sf::st_bbox(bnd)),
                              n = c(8, 20)) |>
  sf::st_as_sf() |>
  rename(geometry = x) |>
  mutate(cell = dplyr::row_number())

# st_join assigns each point to ONE cell (the first match), so a point lying
# exactly on a cell boundary cannot be double-counted.
cell_of <- sf::st_join(fire_px["pixel_id"], grid_poly, join = sf::st_intersects) |>
  sf::st_drop_geometry() |>
  dplyr::distinct(pixel_id, .keep_all = TRUE)
counts <- as.data.frame(table(cell = cell_of$cell), stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
grid_poly$n <- counts$Freq[match(grid_poly$cell, as.integer(counts$cell))]
grid_poly$n[is.na(grid_poly$n)] <- 0L
grid_poly <- grid_poly[lengths(sf::st_intersects(grid_poly, bnd)) > 0, ]

p_q1 <- ggplot() +
  geom_sf(data = grid_poly, aes(fill = n), colour = "white", linewidth = 0.12) +
  geom_sf(data = bnd, fill = NA, colour = "#1c1917", linewidth = 0.5) +
  scale_fill_fire(name = "Pixel-days", trans = "sqrt") +

       subtitle = paste0("Mean ", sprintf("%.1f", FO_Q$mean_count[3]),

                         " per occupied quadrat")) +
  theme_map(11)

  mutate(lab = paste0(nx, "×", ny),
         cell_km = sqrt((diff(win$xrange)/nx) * (diff(win$yrange)/ny)) / 1000) |>
  ggplot(aes(cell_km, vmr)) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 1, linetype = "22", colour = PAL$theo) +

Table 11: Monte-Carlo quadrat tests of complete spatial randomness at four grid resolutions (999 simulations each).四种格网分辨率下针对完全空间随机性的蒙特卡洛样方检验(各 999 次模拟)。(下表为英文原表)





The test rejects CSR at every resolution (\(p =\) 0.002 throughout, the smallest value resolvable with 999 simulations). This is expected and, on its own, almost uninformative, for two reasons that are worth stating because they motivate everything that follows.
First, the variance-to-mean ratio is not a property of the pattern but of the grid: it falls from 424 at the coarsest resolution to 129 at 8 × 20. Any single number quoted from this method is an artefact of an arbitrary choice.
Second, and more fundamentally, the test cannot distinguish intensity variation from interaction. Its null hypothesis bundles “constant intensity” and “independent points” together, so rejection identifies neither. This is precisely the confounding described in § 4.3, and it is why § 6 builds an inhomogeneous reference model instead.


该检验在每一种分辨率下都拒绝 CSR(\(p\) 一律为 0.002,即 999 次模拟所能分辨的最小 值)。这既是预料之中的,单独看也几乎没有信息量,原因有两条,值得写出来,因为 它们构成了后文全部工作的动机。
第一,方差-均值比不是模式的性质,而是格网的性质:它从最粗分辨率下的 424 降到 8 × 20 时的 129。任何从这个方法里引用的单一数字都是某个任意选择的 产物。
第二,也更根本:该检验无法区分强度变化与交互作用。它的原假设把「常数强度」与 「点相互独立」捆在一起,因此拒绝并不能识别出是哪一个。这正是 § 4.3 中 描述的混淆,也是 § 6 转而构建一个非齐次参照模型的原因。

text:
5.3 Kernel intensity estimation, and the bandwidth decision核强度估计,以及带宽这个决策

Addresses RQ1.


对应 RQ1。


Kernel density estimation replaces arbitrary quadrats with a smooth estimate \[
\hat\lambda(u) \;=\; \frac{1}{e(u)}\sum_{i=1}^{n} \kappa_\sigma(u - x_i),
\] where \(\kappa_\sigma\) is an isotropic Gaussian kernel of standard deviation \(\sigma\) and \(e(u)\) is Diggle’s edge correction, the fraction of the kernel mass falling inside the window (Diggle, 1985). Everything then depends on \(\sigma\).


核密度估计用一个平滑估计取代任意划定的样方 \[
\hat\lambda(u) \;=\; \frac{1}{e(u)}\sum_{i=1}^{n} \kappa_\sigma(u - x_i),
\] 其中 \(\kappa_\sigma\) 是标准差为 \(\sigma\) 的各向同性高斯核,\(e(u)\) 是 Diggle 的 边界校正项,即核质量落在窗口内的比例 (Diggle, 1985)。于是一切都取决于 \(\sigma\)。
