The selectors disagree by a factor of forty, and two of them fail a basic admissibility check.


这些选择器之间相差达四十倍,而且其中两个通不过一项基本的可接受性检查。







ImportantWhy bw.diggle and bw.ppl are rejected here



bw.diggle returns \(\sigma =\) 337 m and bw.ppl returns 437 m. Both are at or below the 375 m nominal pixel size of the data. A density surface smoothed at that scale would resolve features smaller than a single observation, so its apparent detail would describe the VIIRS detection grid rather than the fire field, the precision trap identified in § 3.
This is not a failure of the selectors. bw.diggle minimises mean squared error for a Cox process and bw.ppl maximises a likelihood cross-validation criterion (Loader, 1999); both are answering the question “what bandwidth best recovers this point pattern”, and the answer is legitimately small because the pattern is tightly clustered. The mismatch is that our question is about fire, and the pattern’s fine structure is not about fire.
At the other extreme, bw.CvL returns 13,688 m (Cronie & Lieshout, 2018) and bw.scott returns 4,910 × 12,291 m. At 13 km any surface is smoother than the kecamatan the planner acts on, which erases exactly the structure of interest. The bw.scott result is also informative in its own right: its two components differ by a factor of 2.5, a direct measure of how badly a single isotropic bandwidth suits this elongated window.








Important为什么在此处否决 bw.diggle 与 bw.ppl



bw.diggle 给出 \(\sigma =\) 337 m, bw.ppl 给出 437 m。两者都等于或低于 数据本身的 375 m 标称像元尺寸。在该尺度上平滑出的密度面会分辨出比单个观测更小的 特征,因此它表面上的细节描述的是 VIIRS 探测格网,而不是火场,也就是 § 3 中指出的那个精度陷阱。
这不是选择器的失败。bw.diggle 最小化 Cox 过程下的均方误差,bw.ppl 最大化 似然交叉验证准则 (Loader, 1999);两者回答的都是「什么带宽最能还原这个点模式」, 而由于该模式高度聚集,答案理应很小。错配之处在于:我们的问题是关于火的, 而该模式的细部结构并不关于火。
在另一个极端,bw.CvL 给出 13,688 m (Cronie & Lieshout, 2018), bw.scott 给出 4,910 × 12,291 m。 在 13 km 上,任何面都比规划者实际操作的区(kecamatan)更平滑,而这恰恰抹掉了我们 关心的结构。bw.scott 的结果本身也很有信息量:它的两个分量相差 2.5 倍,这直接度量了 单一各向同性带宽对这个狭长窗口有多不适配。



The bandwidth is therefore chosen on substantive grounds, and the full sensitivity ladder is shown so that the reader can judge the choice rather than accept it.


因此带宽是基于实质性理由选定的,并且完整展示整个敏感性阶梯,以便读者能够 评判这一选择,而不是被动接受它。



Code
bw_panels <- lapply(seq_along(FO_K$sigma_ladder), function(k) {
  s  <- FO_K$sigma_ladder[k]
  d  <- im_df(FO_K$dens[[k]], "lam", scale = 1e6)
  ttl <- bquote(sigma == .(n_fmt(s)) ~ "m")
  ggplot() +
    geom_raster(data = d, aes(x, y, fill = lam)) +
    geom_sf(data = bnd, fill = NA, colour = "#1c1917", linewidth = 0.35) +
    scale_fill_fire(name = NULL, trans = "sqrt",
                    labels = label_number(accuracy = 0.1)) +
    labs(title = ttl,
         subtitle = sprintf("peak %.1f/km²  (%.0f× mean)",
                            FO_K$int_check$max_per_km2[k],
                            FO_K$int_check$ratio_max_to_mean[k])) +
    theme_map(10) +
    theme(legend.key.height = unit(0.75, "cm"),
          plot.subtitle = element_text(size = rel(0.8)))
})

pts_panel <- ggplot() +
  geom_sf(data = bnd, fill = "#fafaf9", colour = "#1c1917", linewidth = 0.35) +
  geom_sf(data = fire_px, colour = PAL$fire, size = 0.16, alpha = 0.45) +
  labs(title = "The points themselves",
       subtitle = paste0(n_fmt(N_PX), " pixel-days")) +
  theme_map(10) +
  theme(plot.subtitle = element_text(size = rel(0.8)))

patchwork::wrap_plots(c(list(pts_panel), bw_panels), nrow = 1)








Figure 7: The same 2,715 points at five bandwidths. Each panel has its own colour scale, because the point is the change in spatial structure, not the change in peak value.同样的 2,715 个点在五种带宽下的结果。各图各自配色标尺,因为要看的是空间结构的变化,而不是峰值大小的变化。






What the bandwidth decides. At \(\sigma =\) 500 m the surface is a near-replica of the point locations: the peak is 92× the mean and the “structure” is individual pixel clumps. At 10 km the peak is only 4.5× the mean and the central concentration has been smeared across half the regency. The middle panels show a stable feature that survives both extremes: a high-intensity band in the central-southern regency, with the north almost empty. Evidence for the choice of \(\sigma = 2{,}000\) m: it preserves that band, exceeds the resolution floor by a factor of five, and sits well below the ~20 km scale of a kecamatan. One qualification: every panel integrates to within 0.3% of the point count except \(\sigma =\) 10 km, which overshoots by 4.9%, edge correction becomes unreliable when the bandwidth approaches the window’s width.


带宽决定了什么。 在 \(\sigma =\) 500 m 时,该面几乎是点位置的复制品:峰值为均值的 92×,而所谓「结构」只是一个个 像元团块。在 10 km 时,峰值仅为均值的 4.5×,中部的集中被抹开到了半个 县。中间几幅显示出一个在两个极端下都存活的稳定特征:中南部的一条高强度带, 北部几乎空白。选择 \(\sigma = 2{,}000\) m 的依据: 它保留了这条带、比分辨率下界 高出五倍,并且远低于一个区约 20 km 的尺度。一项限定: 除 \(\sigma =\) 10 km 之外, 每幅的积分都与点数相差在 0.3% 以内;而 10 km 那幅 高出 4.9%,当带宽接近窗口宽度时, 边界校正就变得不可靠了。



Code
k_main <- which(FO_K$sigma_ladder == FO_K$sigma_main)
d_main <- im_df(FO_K$dens[[k_main]], "lam", scale = 1e6)

m1 <- ggplot() +
  geom_raster(data = d_main, aes(x, y, fill = lam)) +
  geom_sf(data = bnd, fill = NA, colour = "#1c1917", linewidth = 0.45) +
  geom_sf(data = kec, fill = NA, colour = "white", linewidth = 0.22,
          linetype = "22") +
  scale_fill_fire(name = "Pixel-days\nper km²", trans = "sqrt",
                  labels = label_number(accuracy = 0.1)) +
  ggspatial::annotation_scale(location = "br", height = unit(0.12, "cm"),
                              text_cex = 0.5, line_width = 0.4) +
  labs(title = "Detection intensity",
       subtitle = paste0("σ = ", n_fmt(FO_K$sigma_main),
                         " m, Diggle edge correction")) +
  theme_map(10)

m2 <- ggplot() +
  geom_raster(data = d_main, aes(x, y, fill = lam), alpha = 0.92) +
  geom_sf(data = osm$canal, colour = "#0e7490", linewidth = 0.10,
          alpha = 0.55) +
  geom_sf(data = bnd, fill = NA, colour = "#1c1917", linewidth = 0.45) +
  scale_fill_fire(name = NULL, trans = "sqrt", guide = "none") +
  labs(title = "The same surface with canals overlaid",
       subtitle = "Blue: OSM canal / drain / ditch") +
  theme_map(10)

m3 <- ggplot() +
  geom_raster(data = im_df(FO_K$dens_adapt, "lam", scale = 1e6),
              aes(x, y, fill = lam)) +
  geom_sf(data = bnd, fill = NA, colour = "#1c1917", linewidth = 0.45) +
  scale_fill_fire(name = "Pixel-days\nper km²", trans = "sqrt",
                  labels = label_number(accuracy = 0.1)) +
  labs(title = "Adaptive bandwidth",
       subtitle = paste0("Abramson rule, h₀ = ", n_fmt(FO_K$sigma_main), " m")) +
  theme_map(10)

m1 + m2 + m3 + patchwork::plot_layout(nrow = 1)








Figure 8: Headline intensity surface at σ = 2,000 m, against the canal network and the kecamatan boundaries.σ = 2,000 m 的主强度面,叠加运河网络与区(kecamatan)界。






The surface at 2 km. Intensity ranges from effectively zero to 10.8 pixel-days per km² (a 39-fold range around the mean) and is organised as one broad concentration across the central-southern regency plus a secondary southern focus, with the northern third nearly empty. The centre panel shows this concentration coinciding with the dense canal grid, and the empty north coinciding with its absence. Evidence: the association is quantified formally in § 5.5; here it is only visual. The adaptive estimate (right) sharpens the peaks without changing their location, confirming the structure is not an artefact of the fixed bandwidth. Read with care: the southern boundary is a coast, where edge correction assumes a process that does not exist offshore, so coastal intensities are biased upward.


2 km 下的强度面。 强度从实际为零一直到 10.8 个像元-日/km²(围绕均值约 39 倍的幅度)其组织形态 是横跨中南部的一片宽阔集中区,加上南部一个次级中心,而北部三分之一几乎空白。中间 一幅显示这片集中区与密集的运河格网重合,而空白的北部与运河的缺失重合。证据: 该关联在 § 5.5 中被正式量化;此处只是视觉上的。自适应估计(右)在不 改变峰值位置的情况下使其更锐利,印证了该结构并非固定带宽造成的假象。阅读时请留意: 南界 为海岸,边界校正在那里假定了一个离岸并不存在的过程,因此沿海强度被高估。

title: Take-home Exercise 1: Fire on Drained Peat课后作业一：排水泥炭地上的火
section: 5.4 The unit that planners act on规划者实际操作的单元
text:
5.4 The unit that planners act on规划者实际操作的单元

A continuous surface is the right object for statistical analysis, but budgets, patrols and permits are administered by kecamatan.


连续面是统计分析的正确对象,但预算、巡护与许可都是按区(kecamatan)管理的。



Code
kd <- kec |> sf::st_drop_geometry() |>
  select(adm3_name, area_km2, n_pxday, rate_per_1000km2, share_pct)

m_kec <- ggplot() +
  geom_sf(data = kec, aes(fill = rate_per_1000km2), colour = "white",
          linewidth = 0.35) +
  geom_sf(data = bnd, fill = NA, colour = "#1c1917", linewidth = 0.45) +
  ggrepel::geom_text_repel(
    data = sf::st_point_on_surface(kec),
    aes(geometry = geometry,
        label = paste0(adm3_name, "\n", round(rate_per_1000km2))),
    stat = "sf_coordinates", size = 2.35, lineheight = 0.92,
    colour = "#1c1917", bg.color = "white", bg.r = 0.13, seed = 11,
    min.segment.length = 0.3, segment.size = 0.25) +
  scale_fill_fire(name = "Pixel-days per\n1,000 km²", trans = "sqrt",
                  labels = label_number(accuracy = 1)) +
  labs(title = "Rate per unit area") +
  theme_map(10)

p_kec <- kd |>
  mutate(adm3_name = forcats::fct_reorder(adm3_name, share_pct)) |>
  tidyr::pivot_longer(c(rate_per_1000km2, share_pct)) |>
  mutate(name = recode(name,
                       rate_per_1000km2 = "Pixel-days per 1,000 km²",
                       share_pct = "Share of all pixel-days (%)")) |>
  ggplot(aes(value, adm3_name)) +
  geom_col(fill = PAL$fire_l, width = 0.68) +
  geom_text(aes(label = round(value, 1)), hjust = -0.15, size = 2.8,
            colour = PAL$grey) +
  facet_wrap(~name, scales = "free_x") +
  scale_x_continuous(expand = expansion(mult = c(0, 0.18))) +
  labs(title = "Two different questions, two different answers",
       x = NULL, y = NULL) +
  theme_th(10) + theme(panel.grid.major.y = element_blank())

m_kec + p_kec + patchwork::plot_layout(widths = c(0.42, 0.58))








Figure 9: Detections aggregated to the eight kecamatan. Rate per 1,000 km² identifies where fire is concentrated relative to area; share of total identifies where most of it actually is.聚合到八个区的探测。每千 km² 发生率识别的是「相对面积而言火集中在哪」;占总量比例识别的是「火的大部分实际在哪」。






Rate against count. The two panels rank the districts differently, and the difference matters operationally. Pandih Batu has the highest rate (1465 pixel-days per 1,000 km², about 5× the regency average), but holds only 24% of all detections because it is small. Sebangau Kuala has a middling rate but 36% of the total, because it is 3.8× the average district in size. Maliku is the striking outlier, with 3 pixel-days despite adjoining the worst-affected district, a contrast worth investigating, since both were Mega Rice Project transmigration areas. One limit: both measures inherit the modifiable areal unit problem; the continuous surface above is the better basis for inference, and this figure is for targeting, not for testing.


速率与计数之别。 两幅图对各区的排序不同,而这个差异在操作上很要紧。 Pandih Batu 的发生率最高(1465 个像元-日/ 千 km²,约为全县均值的 5×)但因面积小,只占全部探测的 24%。 Sebangau Kuala 发生率中等,却占了总量的 36%,因为它的面积 是平均区的 3.8×。 Maliku 是显眼的异常:它紧邻受灾最重的区,却只有 3 个像元-日。这一反差值得追查,因为两者都是 百万公顷稻米工程的移民安置区。一点限度: 两个指标都继承了可变面元问题;上文的连续 面才是更好的推断基础,本图用于瞄准,不用于检验。

title: Take-home Exercise 1: Fire on Drained Peat课后作业一：排水泥炭地上的火
section: 5.5 Intensity as a function of covariates强度作为协变量的函数
text:
5.5 Intensity as a function of covariates强度作为协变量的函数

Addresses RQ3.


对应 RQ3。


Mapping intensity says where; relating it to covariates begins to say why. Two complementary approaches are used, one that makes no functional assumption and one that makes no smoothing assumption.


绘制强度回答的是在哪里;把它与协变量联系起来,才开始回答为什么。此处使用两种 互补的方法:一种不作任何函数形式假设,另一种不作任何平滑假设。


5.5.1 The distribution-free comparison免分布假设的比较

If intensity were unrelated to a covariate \(Z\), the distribution of \(Z\) at the detections would match its distribution across the window. Comparing those two distributions requires no smoothing and no model.


如果强度与某个协变量 \(Z\) 无关,那么 \(Z\) 在探测点上的分布应与它在整个窗口上的分布 一致。比较这两个分布既不需要平滑,也不需要模型。



Code
cov_long <- bind_rows(lapply(names(covars), function(nm) {
  at_pts <- FO_C$cov_at_pts[, nm]
  in_win <- as.vector(covars[[nm]][win, drop = TRUE])
  bind_rows(
    tibble(covariate = nm, km = at_pts / 1000, where = "At detections"),
    tibble(covariate = nm, km = in_win / 1000, where = "Across the window"))
}))

lbl <- c(d_canal = "Distance to canal / drain",
         d_river = "Distance to natural river",
         d_road  = "Distance to road",
         d_settle = "Distance to settlement")

ggplot(cov_long, aes(km, colour = where)) +
  stat_ecdf(linewidth = 0.75, pad = FALSE) +
  facet_wrap(~covariate, scales = "free_x", nrow = 1,
             labeller = labeller(covariate = lbl)) +
  scale_colour_manual(NULL, values = c(`At detections` = PAL$fire,
                                       `Across the window` = PAL$grey)) +
  scale_y_continuous(labels = label_percent()) +
  labs(title = "Detections are closer to canals, and further from rivers, than chance",
       subtitle = "Empirical cumulative distributions; a red curve to the LEFT of grey means 'closer than expected'",
       x = "Distance (km)", y = "Cumulative proportion") +
  theme_th(11)








Figure 10: For each covariate, the cumulative distribution of its value at the detections (red) against its distribution across the whole window (grey). Separation between the curves is evidence that intensity depends on the covariate; the direction of separation gives the sign.对每个协变量,红线为其在探测点上的取值累积分布,灰线为其在整个窗口上的分布。两条曲线分离即为「强度依赖于该协变量」的证据,分离方向给出效应符号。







Code
FO_C$cov_compare |>
  left_join(FO_C$cov_tests, by = "covariate") |>
  transmute(Covariate = lbl[covariate],
            `Median at detections (m)` = median_at_detections,
            `Median in window (m)` = median_in_window,
            Ratio = ratio,
            `KS D` = ks_D, `Berman Z₁` = Z1,
            Direction = direction) |>
  gt::gt() |>
  gt::fmt_number(columns = c(`KS D`), decimals = 3) |>
  gt::fmt_number(columns = `Berman Z₁`, decimals = 1) |>
  gt::fmt_number(columns = Ratio, decimals = 2) |>
  gt::data_color(columns = Ratio,
                 fn = scales::col_numeric(c("#b91c1c", "#f5f5f4", "#0e7490"),
                                          domain = c(0.4, 1.5))) |>
  gt::tab_options(table.font.size = gt::pct(82), data_row.padding = gt::px(5))

Table 13: Covariate values at detections against the window, with formal tests. Both tests assume independent points, which is false here, so the p-values are anti-conservative and are reported for direction and rough strength only.探测点处与整个窗口的协变量取值对比,并附正式检验。两项检验都假定点独立,而此处不成立,因此 p 值是反保守的,仅用于判断方向与大致强度。(下表为英文原表)





The signal is clear and, in one respect, counter-intuitive.

Canals. The median detection is 559 m from a canal, against 1,119 m for a random location in the window, half the distance. This is the strongest effect of the four (\(Z_1 =\) -15.8).
Natural rivers. The direction reverses: detections are 35% further from rivers than chance. Proximity to water per se is not the driver; proximity to engineered drainage is. This is exactly the dissociation the covariate pair was designed to test, and it is the single most useful result in this section, because it distinguishes a hydrological mechanism from a generic “near water” association.
Roads and settlements show weaker effects in the “closer” direction, consistent with human ignition but much less pronounced than canals.



信号很清晰,而且在一个方面是反直觉的。

运河。 探测点到运河的中位距为 559 m, 而窗口内随机位置为 1,119 m ,只有一半的距离。这是四者中最强的效应(\(Z_1 =\) -15.8)。
天然河流。 方向反转:探测点比随机情形更远离河流 35%。 驱动因素不是「靠水」本身,而是靠近人工排水。这恰恰是设置这一对协变量所要 检验的分离,也是这一节最有用的单项结果,因为它把一个水文机制与泛泛的「靠水」 关联区分开了。
道路与居民点在「更近」方向上显示出较弱的效应,与人为点火一致,但远不如运河 明显。




Code
# Small helpers: read the rhohat curve at a covariate value, and find the first
# covariate value at which the curve drops below a reference intensity. Written
# as explicit lookups rather than approx() on the response, because rho(Z) is
# not monotone and inverse interpolation on a non-monotone curve is undefined.
rho_at <- function(r, z) {
  d <- as.data.frame(r)
  approx(d$X, d$rho * 1e6, xout = z, rule = 2)$y
}
rho_crosses_mean <- function(r, mean_int) {
  d <- as.data.frame(r)
  below <- which(d$rho * 1e6 < mean_int)
  if (!length(below)) return(NA_real_)
  d$X[min(below)]
}

rho_long <- bind_rows(lapply(names(FO_R), function(nm) {
  d <- as.data.frame(FO_R[[nm]])
  tibble(covariate = nm, km = d$X / 1000,
         rho = d$rho * 1e6, lo = d$lo * 1e6, hi = d$hi * 1e6,
         ave = d$ave * 1e6)
}))

ggplot(rho_long, aes(km)) +
  geom_ribbon(aes(ymin = pmax(lo, 0), ymax = hi), fill = PAL$fire_xl,
              alpha = 0.75) +
  geom_line(aes(y = rho), colour = PAL$fire, linewidth = 0.8) +
  geom_hline(aes(yintercept = ave), linetype = "22", colour = PAL$theo,
             linewidth = 0.4) +
  facet_wrap(~covariate, scales = "free", nrow = 1,
             labeller = labeller(covariate = lbl)) +
  labs(title = expression(paste("Estimated ", rho(Z),
                                ": intensity as a function of each covariate")),
       subtitle = "Dashed line: window-wide mean intensity. Shaded: 95% pointwise band.",
       x = "Distance (km)", y = expression(paste("Pixel-days per ", km^2))) +
  theme_th(11)








Figure 11: Non-parametric intensity as a function of each covariate, with 95% confidence bands. The horizontal line is the window-wide mean intensity.强度作为各协变量函数的非参数估计,并附 95% 置信带。水平线为全窗口平均强度。






Along each covariate. Distance to canal shows a clean monotone decline: intensity is roughly 0.35 per km² adjacent to a canal, 0.16 at 5 km, and 0.11 at 10 km, crossing below the window-wide mean at about 2.0 km. Distance to river runs the other way, rising with distance. Road and settlement curves peak a few kilometres out rather than at zero, plausibly because the immediate surroundings of roads and villages are cleared or actively defended, while the accessible hinterland burns. Evidence: the confidence bands are narrow over the range where most of the window lies; they widen at large distances where few locations exist. A caveat: these are marginal relationships. The covariates are mutually correlated, and a bivariate curve cannot separate them, which is the motivation for the multivariate model in § 7. Bands also assume independent points, so they are too narrow.


沿各协变量看。 到运河的距离呈现干净的单调下降:紧邻运河处强度约 0.35 个/km²,5 km 处为 0.16,10 km 处为 0.11(大约在 2.0 km 处降到全窗口 均值以下。到河流的距离则方向相反,随距离上升。道路与居民点的曲线峰值出现在数公里 之外而不是零处)可能是因为道路与村庄的紧邻区域已被清理或受到主动防护,而可达的 腹地在烧。证据: 在窗口大部分取值所在的范围内置信带很窄;在位置样本很少的大 距离处置信带变宽。一点保留: 这些都是边际关系。各协变量彼此相关,二元曲线无法把 它们分开。这正是 § 7 中建立多变量模型的动因。另外置信带同样假定点独立,因此 偏窄。

title: Take-home Exercise 1: Fire on Drained Peat课后作业一：排水泥炭地上的火
section: 5.6 Spatio-temporal intensity时空强度
text:
5.6 Spatio-temporal intensity时空强度

Finally, intensity is allowed to vary in space and time. Two estimates are presented for the same data, because they answer slightly different questions.


最后,允许强度同时在空间和时间上变化。对同一批数据给出两种估计,因为它们回答 的问题略有不同。



Code
days <- FO_ST$days

# Shared scale limits make the daily panels comparable with one another.
dd <- bind_rows(lapply(seq_along(days), function(k)
  im_df(FO_ST$dens_daily[[k]], "lam", scale = 1e6) |>
    mutate(day = format(days[k], "%d %b"))))
dd$day <- factor(dd$day, levels = format(days, "%d %b"))

n_by_day <- as.integer(table(factor(fire_px$date_local, levels = days)))
lab_day  <- setNames(sprintf("%s  (n = %s)", format(days, "%d %b"),
                             n_fmt(n_by_day)), format(days, "%d %b"))

p_top <- ggplot() +
  geom_raster(data = dd, aes(x, y, fill = lam)) +
  geom_sf(data = bnd, fill = NA, colour = "#1c1917", linewidth = 0.25) +
  facet_wrap(~day, nrow = 1, labeller = labeller(day = lab_day)) +
  scale_fill_fire(name = "per km²\nper day", trans = "sqrt",
                  labels = label_number(accuracy = 0.1)) +
  labs(title = "Independent daily kernel surfaces",
       subtitle = paste0("σ = ", n_fmt(FO_ST$sigma),
                         " m; no temporal smoothing, so each panel is that day's evidence alone")) +
  theme_map(9) +
  theme(strip.text = element_text(size = rel(0.78)),
        legend.key.height = unit(0.6, "cm"))

# The conditional surfaces are probability densities over ~9.8e9 m2, so raw
# values are ~1e-10 and would print as "0.0" in any legend. Rescaling to
# "per 1,000 km2" makes them readable without altering the surface.
dc <- bind_rows(lapply(seq_along(FO_ST$stkde$z.cond), function(k)
  im_df(FO_ST$stkde$z.cond[[k]], "lam", scale = 1e9) |>
    mutate(day = format(days[k], "%d %b"))))
dc$day <- factor(dc$day, levels = format(days, "%d %b"))

p_bot <- ggplot() +
  geom_raster(data = dc, aes(x, y, fill = lam)) +
  geom_sf(data = bnd, fill = NA, colour = "#1c1917", linewidth = 0.25) +
  facet_wrap(~day, nrow = 1) +
  scale_fill_fire(name = "share of the day\nper 1,000 km²", trans = "sqrt",
                  labels = label_number(accuracy = 0.01)) +
  labs(title = "Separable spatio-temporal KDE, conditional on day",
       subtitle = paste0("h = ", n_fmt(FO_ST$sigma), " m, λ = ",
                         FO_ST$lambda_t,
                         " day; each panel integrates to 1, so it shows *where*, not *how much*")) +
  theme_map(9) +
  theme(strip.text = element_text(size = rel(0.78)),
        legend.key.height = unit(0.6, "cm"))

p_top / p_bot








Figure 12: Spatio-temporal intensity. Top: one independent kernel surface per local day, shared colour scale, units of pixel-days per km² per day. Bottom: separable spatio-temporal KDE with a one-day temporal bandwidth, shown as the spatial density conditional on the day.时空强度。上排:每个当地日一个独立的核估计面,共用配色标尺,单位为「每 km² 每日的像元-日」。下排:时间带宽为一天的可分离时空 KDE,以「给定该日的空间密度」形式呈现。






Sorting signal from sampling. The top row is dominated by count differences already shown to be observational: 7 Sep (n = 74, one overpass) is almost blank. Conditioning on the day removes that, and the bottom row reveals what the top row obscures, the concentration sits in the same central-southern band on every one of the eight days, with a modest late southward extension. Evidence: the conditional surfaces peak in the same place throughout, and the fully-covered days (5, 6, 10, 11 Sep) agree. Implication: the spatial pattern is stable at this time scale, so a surface estimated over the whole window is a fair summary rather than an average of shifting states. Worth noting: with λ = 1 day adjacent panels share information by construction, so some apparent persistence is imposed by the smoother; the unsmoothed top row is the check.


把信号与采样分开。 上排由已被证明属于观测性的计数差异所主导:9 月 7 日 (n = 74,只有一次过境)几乎空白。以「给定该日」作条件后,下排揭示出 上排所掩盖的内容,集中区在全部八天里都位于同一条中南部条带内,后期略向南延伸。 证据: 各条件面在整个时段都在同一位置出现峰值,而覆盖完整的那几天(9 月 5、6、 10、11 日)与之一致。含义: 在这个时间尺度上空间格局是稳定的,因此在整个窗口上 估计的强度面是一个公允的汇总,而不是若干不断变化状态的平均。需注意: 由于 λ = 1 天,相邻各幅在构造上共享信息,因此部分表面上的持续性是平滑器强加的;未作时间 平滑的上排就是对此的检查。

section: 6.1 Parameters common to this section本节通用参数
text:
6.1 Parameters common to this section本节通用参数


Estimation settings
NSIM <- SO$nsim          # 199 simulations -> global envelope level 2/200 = 1%
CORR <- SO$corr          # Ohser-Stoyan translation correction
r_K  <- SO$r_K           # 0 to 15 km
r_G  <- SO$r_G           # 0 to 3 km

tibble::tibble(
  Setting = c("Analysis unit", "Simulations per envelope", "Envelope type",
              "Edge correction (K, L, g)", "Edge correction (G, F, J)",
              "r range (L)", "r range (G, F)", "Window bounding box"),
  Value = c(
    paste0("pixel-day, n = ", n_fmt(N_PX)),
    paste0(NSIM, " (+ ", NSIM, " for the reference mean where the null is not CSR)"),
    "global (constant width), α = 0.01",
    CORR, "Kaplan–Meier",
    paste0("0 – ", n_fmt(max(r_K)), " m"),
    paste0("0 – ", n_fmt(max(r_G)), " m"),
    sprintf("%.0f × %.0f km", diff(win$xrange)/1000, diff(win$yrange)/1000))
) |>
  gt::gt() |>
  gt::tab_options(table.font.size = gt::pct(85), data_row.padding = gt::px(4))








Setting
Value




Analysis unit
pixel-day, n = 2,715


Simulations per envelope
199 (+ 199 for the reference mean where the null is not CSR)

86 × 213 km








Two choices need a word of explanation.
Why global envelopes. A pointwise envelope is read at every one of ~200 distances, so its nominal 1% level applies to each \(r\) separately and the probability of some excursion under the null is far higher than 1% (A. Baddeley et al., 2014). A global envelope has a constant width chosen so that the probability of the observed curve leaving it anywhere in the \(r\) range is exactly \(2/(199+1) = 1\%\). Every envelope in this section is global, and each is accompanied by a single \(p\)-value from a Diggle–Cressie–Loosmore–Ford (DCLF) or maximum-absolute-deviation (MAD) test, so that no conclusion depends on selectively reading a curve (Myllymäki et al., 2017).
Why \(L\) rather than \(K\). A constant-width band applied to \(K(r)\), whose variance grows like \(r^4\), is set by the largest distances and is effectively blind at small \(r\). All envelopes therefore use the variance-stabilised \(L(r) = \sqrt{K(r)/\pi}\), which under a Poisson process equals \(r\). Plots below show \(L(r)\) minus its reference curve, so a horizontal line at zero is the null and any departure is read directly in metres.


有两项选择需要说明。
为什么用全局包络。 逐点包络会在约 200 个距离上分别被读取,因此其名义 1% 水平 只对每个 \(r\) 单独成立,而在零模型下曲线在某处越界的概率远高于 1% (A. Baddeley et al., 2014)。全局包络的宽度是常数,并使观测曲线在整个 \(r\) 范围内 任何地方越界的概率恰好为 \(2/(199+1) = 1\%\)。以下所有包络都是全局的,并且每个都 配有一个来自 Diggle–Cressie–Loosmore–Ford(DCLF)或最大绝对偏差(MAD)检验的单一 \(p\) 值,从而使任何结论都不依赖于对曲线的选择性阅读 (Myllymäki et al., 2017)。
为什么用 \(L\) 而不用 \(K\)。 把常宽带用在 \(K(r)\) 上时,由于其方差按 \(r^4\) 增长, 带宽实际由最大距离决定,在小 \(r\) 处近乎失明。因此所有包络都使用方差稳定化的 \(L(r) = \sqrt{K(r)/\pi}\),它在泊松过程下等于 \(r\)。下文各图显示的是 \(L(r)\) 减去其参照曲线,因此零水平线就是零模型,任何偏离都可以直接以米读取。

section: 6.2 N1: against complete spatial randomness, and why it settles nothingN1:对照完全空间随机性,以及它为何解决不了任何问题
text:
6.2 N1: against complete spatial randomness, and why it settles nothingN1:对照完全空间随机性,以及它为何解决不了任何问题

Question tested. Is the pattern distinguishable from a uniform random scatter of the same number of points in the same window? Null model N1: homogeneous Poisson, simulated by runifpoint(n, W).


所检验的问题。 该模式能否与同一窗口内、同样点数的均匀随机散布区分开? 零模型 N1: 齐次泊松过程,由 runifpoint(n, W) 模拟。



Code
gf <- function(e, ttl, sub, ylab) {
  d <- as.data.frame(e)
  ggplot(d, aes(r / 1000)) +
    geom_ribbon(aes(ymin = lo, ymax = hi, fill = "band"), alpha = 0.9) +
    geom_line(aes(y = theo, colour = "theo"), linetype = "22", linewidth = 0.5) +
    geom_line(aes(y = obs, colour = "obs"), linewidth = 0.85) +
    scale_fill_manual(NULL, values = c(band = PAL$env),
                      labels = "Global envelope") +
    scale_colour_manual(NULL, values = c(obs = PAL$fire, theo = PAL$theo),
                        labels = c(obs = "Observed", theo = "CSR"),
                        breaks = c("obs", "theo")) +
    labs(title = ttl, subtitle = sub, x = "Distance r (km)", y = ylab) +
    theme_th(10)
}

gf(SO$env_G, "G: nearest-neighbour distances",
   "Observed far ABOVE CSR → neighbours much closer than random",
   "G(r)") +
gf(SO$env_F, "F: empty-space distances",
   "Observed far BELOW CSR → large empty gaps exist",
   "F(r)") +
gf(SO$env_J, "J = (1−G)/(1−F)",
   "J < 1 throughout → clustering, not inhibition",
   "J(r)") +
  patchwork::plot_layout(nrow = 1, guides = "collect") &
  theme(legend.position = "bottom")








Figure 13: Nearest-neighbour (G), empty-space (F) and J functions against complete spatial randomness. All three reject CSR decisively at every distance examined.最近邻(G)、空隙(F)与 J 函数对照完全空间随机性。三者在所考察的每个距离上都决定性地拒绝 CSR。







Code
plot_env_centred(
  SO$env_L_csr,
  title = "N1: L(r) against complete spatial randomness",
  subtitle = paste0("DCLF u = ",
                    formatC(stat_of(SO$test_L_csr), format = "g", digits = 3),
                    ", p ", pv(SO$test_L_csr$p.value),
                    "  ·  MAD p ", pv(SO$mad_L_csr$p.value),
                    "  ·  ", NSIM, " simulations"),
  caption = "This rejection was a foregone conclusion: the first-order analysis already showed intensity varying ~40-fold.",
  ref_lab = "CSR")








Figure 14: L function against CSR, centred on the theoretical value. The global envelope is so narrow relative to the observed excess that it is barely visible.L 函数对照 CSR,以理论值为中心。相对观测到的超额,全局包络窄到几乎看不见。






Every statistic rejects CSR at the smallest attainable \(p\)-value (0.005, the floor for 199 simulations). The mean nearest-neighbour distance is 263 m against 960 m expected under CSR (simulated 2.5–97.5% interval 944–976 m), a ratio of 0.27, so observed neighbours are about 3.7 times closer together than random.


每一个统计量都在所能达到的最小 \(p\) 值上拒绝 CSR (0.005,即 199 次模拟的下限)。平均最近邻距离为 263 m,而 CSR 下的期望为 960 m(模拟 2.5–97.5% 区间 944–976 m),比值为 0.27,即观测到的邻居之间的距离约为随机情形的 3.7 分之一。







WarningThis tells us almost nothing



The result is real but uninformative, and the reason is structural, not statistical. CSR bundles two hypotheses (constant intensity and independent points) into one null. The first-order analysis already demonstrated that constant intensity is false, with intensity ranging over roughly 39-fold around the mean. Rejection of N1 was therefore guaranteed before any second-order statistic was computed, and it cannot be attributed to interaction.








Warning这几乎没有告诉我们任何东西



这个结果是真实的,但没有信息量,而原因是结构性的而非统计性的。CSR 把两个假设(常数强度与点相互独立)捆进了一个零模型。一阶分析已经证明常数强度不成立: 强度围绕均值的变化幅度约 39 倍。因此对 N1 的拒绝在任何二阶统计量被计算之前就已经注定,而且它无法被归因于 交互作用。

title: Take-home Exercise 1: Fire on Drained Peat课后作业一：排水泥炭地上的火
section: 6.3 N2: against an inhomogeneous Poisson processN2:对照非齐次泊松过程
text:
6.3 N2: against an inhomogeneous Poisson processN2:对照非齐次泊松过程

Question tested. Once the large-scale intensity gradient is taken as given, do detections still cluster beyond what that gradient explains? Null model N2: inhomogeneous Poisson with intensity fixed at the kernel estimate \(\hat\lambda_{\sigma_\lambda}\), simulated by rpoispp(lambda_hat). Statistic: \(L_{inhom}(r)\), weighting each pair by \(1/(\hat\lambda(x_i)\hat\lambda(x_j))\) so that intensity variation is divided out (A. J. Baddeley et al., 2000).


所检验的问题。 在把大尺度强度梯度视为已给定之后,探测点是否仍然聚集到超出 该梯度所能解释的程度? 零模型 N2: 非齐次泊松过程,其强度固定为核估计 \(\hat\lambda_{\sigma_\lambda}\),由 rpoispp(lambda_hat) 模拟。 统计量: \(L_{inhom}(r)\),它对每一对点按 \(1/(\hat\lambda(x_i)\hat\lambda(x_j))\) 加权,从而把强度变化除掉 (A. J. Baddeley et al., 2000)。


Two implementation decisions make the comparison legitimate, and both were arrived at after a first attempt failed.

A single fixed intensity. Linhom will re-estimate \(\hat\lambda\) separately for each simulated pattern by leave-one-out kernel smoothing. That was tried first and rejected: it makes observed and simulated statistics incommensurable, and on this pattern it was numerically degenerate, the simulated \(L_{inhom}\) collapsed to zero. Since the null model is “an inhomogeneous Poisson process with intensity \(\hat\lambda\)”, \(\hat\lambda\) is estimated once from the data and the same image is used throughout.
normpower = 2, the normalisation recommended to reduce sensitivity to error in \(\hat\lambda\) (A. J. Baddeley et al., 2000). The spatstat default changed in version 3.8-1, so it is set explicitly.



有两项实现决策使这一比较得以成立,而两者都是在第一次尝试失败之后才确定的。

使用单一固定强度。 Linhom 会用留一核平滑为每个模拟模式分别重新估计 \(\hat\lambda\)。这一做法先被尝试、随后被否决:它使观测统计量与模拟统计量不可 比较,并且在本模式上数值退化,模拟出的 \(L_{inhom}\) 坍缩为零。既然零模型就是 「强度为 \(\hat\lambda\) 的非齐次泊松过程」,那么 \(\hat\lambda\) 就从数据中估计 一次,并在全过程中使用同一张影像。
normpower = 2,即推荐用于降低对 \(\hat\lambda\) 估计误差敏感性的归一化方式 (A. J. Baddeley et al., 2000)。该参数的 spatstat 默认值在 3.8-1 版中有过变更,因此此处显式 设定。



6.3.1 The result: the answer is a function of \(\sigma_\lambda\)结果:答案是 \(\sigma_\lambda\) 的函数


Code
lad <- SO$linhom_ladder
panels <- lapply(seq_along(lad), function(k) {
  x <- lad[[k]]; s <- env_summary(x$env)
  plot_env_centred(
    x$env,
    title = bquote(sigma[lambda] == .(n_fmt(x$sigma)) ~ "m"),
    subtitle = sprintf("DCLF p %s · %s",
                       pv(x$test$p.value),
                       ifelse(is.na(s$r_first), "inside the envelope throughout",
                              sprintf("outside over %.1f–%.1f km",
                                      s$r_first, s$r_last))),
    ref_lab = "Inhomogeneous Poisson") +
    theme_th(10) + theme(legend.position = "none")
})
patchwork::wrap_plots(panels, nrow = 2)








Figure 15: Inhomogeneous L against an inhomogeneous Poisson null at four intensity bandwidths. The observed curve leaves the global envelope only at σ_λ = 10 km.四种强度带宽下,非齐次 L 对照非齐次泊松零模型。观测曲线只在 σ_λ = 10 km 时离开全局包络。







Code

lin_tab <- bind_rows(lapply(lad, function(x) {
  s <- env_summary(x$env)
  cells <- A_KM2 / (pi * (x$sigma / 1000)^2)
  tibble(`σ_λ (m)` = x$sigma,

Table 14: The N2 test as a function of the intensity bandwidth, alongside a count of the resolution cells the null intensity consumes. The two columns move together.N2 检验作为强度带宽的函数,并列出零模型强度所消耗的分辨单元数。这两列是同步变化的。(下表为英文原表)





The pattern in that table is the central methodological finding of this report.


上表中的规律正是这项分析在方法学上的核心发现。



Code
pw <- lin_tab |>
  transmute(sigma = `σ_λ (m)`, cells = `Resolution cells in the null`,
            p = `DCLF p`) |>
  bind_rows(tibble(sigma = NA_real_, cells = VA$n_par_M1,
                   p = VA$gof_M1_test$p.value))
pw$label <- c(sprintf("σ_λ = %s m", n_fmt(pw$sigma[1:4])),
              "covariate model (N4, §7)")

ggplot(pw, aes(cells, p)) +
  annotate("rect", xmin = 1, xmax = Inf, ymin = 0.05, ymax = Inf,
           fill = PAL$grey_l, alpha = 0.35) +
  annotate("text", x = 3.2, y = 0.5, label = "cannot reject the null",
           hjust = 0, size = 3.1, colour = PAL$grey) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 0.05, linetype = "22", colour = PAL$theo) +
  geom_line(data = ~dplyr::filter(.x, !is.na(sigma)), colour = PAL$fire,
            linewidth = 0.7) +
  geom_point(aes(colour = is.na(sigma)), size = 3.4) +
  # geom_label_repel rather than text: these labels sit over a line and two
  # reference rules, and an opaque background keeps both readable.
  ggrepel::geom_label_repel(aes(label = label), size = 3.1, colour = "#292524",
                            seed = 5, min.segment.length = 0.1,
                            box.padding = 0.65, point.padding = 0.35,
                            label.size = 0, label.padding = unit(0.13, "lines"),
                            fill = alpha("white", 0.9),
                            segment.size = 0.3, segment.colour = PAL$grey) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 0, colour = NA) +
  scale_x_log10(labels = label_comma()) +
  scale_y_log10(labels = label_number(accuracy = 0.0001)) +
  scale_colour_manual(values = c(`FALSE` = PAL$fire, `TRUE` = PAL$water),
                      guide = "none") +
  annotate("segment", x = 2715, xend = 2715, y = 0.0015, yend = 1,
           linetype = "33", colour = PAL$water) +
  annotate("text", x = 2715, y = 0.0013, label = "n = 2,715 points",
           size = 2.9, colour = PAL$water, vjust = 1) +
  labs(title = "Power depends on how many parameters the null is allowed",
       subtitle = paste0("The same data, the same statistic, the same 199 ",
                         "simulations — only the null's flexibility changes"),
       x = "Resolution cells / parameters in the null intensity (log scale)",
       y = "DCLF p-value (log scale)") +
  theme_th(11)








Figure 16: Why the N2 test reaches opposite conclusions at different bandwidths: the flexibility of the null intensity, not the data, decides the answer.N2 检验在不同带宽下得出相反结论的原因:决定答案的是零模型强度的灵活度,而不是数据。






Resolution against sample size. At \(\sigma_\lambda = 1\) km the kernel intensity has roughly 3,106 resolution cells for 2,715 points, fewer than one point per cell. Such a null is close to saturated: it can reproduce almost any pattern, so failing to reject it (p = 0.093) carries little information. As \(\sigma_\lambda\) grows, the null becomes parsimonious and the \(p\)-value falls monotonically to 0.0025 at 10 km, where excess clustering appears over 2.7–5.8 km. The covariate model of § 7, with only 5 parameters, sits at the far left and is rejected decisively. Implication: whether the ~2 km structure in this pattern is called “intensity variation” or “clustering” is a modelling choice, not something these data can settle. But note: “resolution cells” is a rough heuristic for the null’s flexibility, not an exact degrees-of-freedom calculation.


分辨单元数与样本量。 在 \(\sigma_\lambda = 1\) km 时,核强度约有 3,106 个分辨单元,而点只有 2,715 个,每个单元不到一个点。这样的零模型接近饱和:它几乎能 再现任何模式,因此「未能拒绝它」(p = 0.093) 所携带的信息很少。随着 \(\sigma_\lambda\) 增大,零模型变得简约,\(p\) 值单调下降到 10 km 时的 0.0025,此时在 2.7–5.8 km 范围内出现超额聚集。§ 7 中仅有 5 个参数的协变量模型位于 最左端,并被决定性地拒绝。含义: 本模式中那个约 2 km 的结构,称之为「强度变化」 还是「聚集」,是一个建模选择,而不是这些数据能够判定的事实。 但请注意:「分辨单元」只是对零模型灵活度的粗略启发式度量,不是精确的自由度计算。







ImportantThe honest statement of the N2 result



At the bandwidth chosen for the headline intensity surface (\(\sigma_\lambda = 2,000\) m), the observed pattern is not distinguishable from an inhomogeneous Poisson process (DCLF \(p =\) 0.080, MAD \(p =\) 0.138, observed curve inside the 1% global envelope at every distance).
It would be wrong to report this as “no clustering”. It is a statement about a test with very little power, for two identifiable reasons:

The null is nearly saturated at this bandwidth, as above.
The inverse-intensity weights are unbounded. \(L_{inhom}\) weights pairs by \(1/(\hat\lambda_i\hat\lambda_j)\), and at \(\sigma_\lambda = 2\) km the fitted intensity at the data points spans a factor of about

A simulated pair falling in the sparse north therefore contributes an enormous amount, giving the null distribution very heavy tails. The consequence is visible in Fig. 17, where the global envelope for \(g_{inhom}\) is roughly ±200 around a null value of 1.


The way out is not a better bandwidth. It is a null model with few parameters, which is what § 7 provides.








Important对 N2 结果的诚实表述



在主强度面所选用的带宽下(\(\sigma_\lambda = 2,000\) m), 观测到的模式与非齐次泊松过程无法区分 (DCLF \(p =\) 0.080, MAD \(p =\) 0.138, 观测曲线在每个距离上都位于 1% 全局包络之内)。
把这说成「没有聚集」是错误的。这是关于一个检验力极低的检验的陈述,而原因有 两条、都可以指认:

在该带宽下零模型近乎饱和,如上所述。
逆强度权重是无界的。 \(L_{inhom}\) 按 \(1/(\hat\lambda_i\hat\lambda_j)\) 对 点对加权,而在 \(\sigma_\lambda = 2\) km 时,数据点处的拟合强度跨度约为 230 倍。因此一对落在稀疏北部的模拟点会贡献一个极大的量,使零分布具有非常重的尾部。 其后果在 Fig. 17 中可见:\(g_{inhom}\) 的全局包络在零值 1 附近大约是 ±200。

出路不是更好的带宽,而是一个参数很少的零模型。这正是 § 7 所提供的。

section: 6.4 Describing the structure, rather than testing it描述这个结构,而不是检验它
text:
6.4 Describing the structure, rather than testing it描述这个结构,而不是检验它

Since the N2 test cannot resolve the question, the pair-correlation function is used here descriptively: it says how much more pairing there is at distance \(r\) than the fitted 2 km intensity implies, without asking whether that excess is significant.


既然 N2 检验无法解决这个问题,此处就把对相关函数当作描述性工具使用:它说明 在距离 \(r\) 上的成对程度比拟合的 2 km 强度所隐含的高出多少,而不追问这一超额是否 显著。



Code
# g(r) is plotted on a log scale, which requires positive values. The r = 0
# endpoint and the lower envelope can both be zero or negative for a
# kernel-smoothed pair-correlation estimate, so those are handled explicitly
# rather than silently dropped by the scale.
gd <- as.data.frame(SO$env_g) |>
  dplyr::filter(r > 0, is.finite(obs), obs > 0) |>
  dplyr::mutate(lo_p = pmax(lo, min(obs) / 3), hi_p = pmax(hi, lo_p * 1.001))

ggplot(gd, aes(r / 1000)) +
  geom_ribbon(aes(ymin = lo_p, ymax = hi_p, fill = "band"), alpha = 0.55) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 1, linetype = "22", colour = PAL$theo,
             linewidth = 0.5) +
  geom_line(aes(y = obs, colour = "obs"), linewidth = 0.95) +
  annotate("rect", xmin = 0, xmax = 0.5, ymin = -Inf, ymax = Inf,
           fill = "#78716c", alpha = 0.22) +
  annotate("segment", x = 0.5, xend = 0.5, y = -Inf, yend = Inf,
           colour = "#57534e", linewidth = 0.4, linetype = "12") +
  annotate("text", x = 0.58, y = max(gd$hi_p), label = "below sensor resolution",
           hjust = 0, vjust = 1.4, size = 2.9, colour = "#57534e") +
  scale_fill_manual(NULL, values = c(band = PAL$env),
                    labels = "Global envelope (uninformatively wide)") +
  scale_colour_manual(NULL, values = c(obs = PAL$fire), labels = "Observed") +
  scale_y_log10(labels = label_number(accuracy = 0.1)) +
  labs(title = expression(paste("Inhomogeneous pair correlation ", g[inhom](r))),
       subtitle = paste0("σ_λ = ", n_fmt(SO$sigma_main),
                         " m · log scale · dashed line at 1 is the null value"),
       x = "Distance r (km)", y = expression(g[inhom](r))) +
  theme_th(11)








Figure 17: Inhomogeneous pair-correlation function relative to the σ_λ = 2 km intensity. The observed curve is shown with the global envelope, which is far too wide to be informative, itself a diagnostic of the weight-explosion problem.相对 σ_λ = 2 km 强度的非齐次对相关函数。图中同时给出全局包络,但它宽到完全没有信息量。这本身就是权重爆炸问题的诊断。

  mutate(`g_inhom(r)` = approx(gd$r, gd$obs, `r (m)`)$y,
         `Excess pairing` = sprintf("%.1f× the null", `g_inhom(r)`)) |>
  gt::gt() |>
  gt::fmt_number(columns = `g_inhom(r)`, decimals = 2) |>
  gt::fmt_number(columns = `r (m)`, decimals = 0) |>

Table 15: Observed inhomogeneous pair correlation at selected distances, relative to the σ_λ = 2 km intensity. Reported descriptively: the envelope is too wide to support a significance claim.若干选定距离上观测到的非齐次对相关值(相对 σ_λ = 2 km 强度)。仅作描述性报告:包络太宽,不足以支持显著性论断。(下表为英文原表)





Excess pairing at short range. Relative to the 2 km kernel intensity there is still substantial excess pairing at short range (17.4× the null at 500 m, 6.6× at 1 km, 3.3× at 2 km) decaying towards but not reaching 1 by 8 km. Evidence: the shape is a clean monotone decay, which is what a clustered process produces. But the envelope spans roughly ±200, so none of this is statistically distinguishable from the null: the inverse-intensity weights make the sampling distribution enormously dispersed. Implication: the descriptive scale of the excess is a few kilometres, and establishing it as real requires the parametric route of § 7, which independently estimates a cluster scale of 2,140 m. One qualification: nothing inside the grey strip may be interpreted at all; and divisor = "d" makes \(g\) intrinsically noisy at very small \(r\).


短程上的超额成对。 相对 2 km 的核强度,短距离上仍存在可观的超额成对(500 m 处为 零模型的 17.4×,1 km 处 6.6×,2 km 处 3.3×)并向 1 衰减,但到 8 km 仍未 达到 1。证据: 其形状是干净的单调衰减,而这正是聚集过程所产生的形态。 但包络跨度约为 ±200,因此这些都无法在统计上与零模型区分:逆强度权重使抽样分布 极度离散。含义: 该超额在描述意义上的尺度是数公里,而要确立它是真实的,需要 § 7 的参数化路径,后者独立估计出的簇群尺度为 2,140 m。一项限定: 灰色条带内的任何内容都不可 解读;另外 divisor = "d" 使 \(g\) 在极小 \(r\) 处本身就很嘈杂。

Table 17: Sensitivity of the observed L_inhom to the normalisation power, whose spatstat default changed in version 3.8-1.观测 L_inhom 对归一化幂次的敏感性;该参数的 spatstat 默认值在 3.8-1 版中有过变更。(下表为英文原表)





Point-event definition. All three units give the same answer at \(\sigma_\lambda = 2\) km, inside the envelope, \(p\) between 0.065 and 0.276. The event unit matters most: it is already de-duplicated in space and time, so it cannot be affected by one fire occupying several pixels. Its agreement confirms that the N2 non-result is a property of the test, not of pixel-level duplication.
It should be noted that the event unit is itself imperfect. Single-linkage chaining merged 23% of all pixel-days into one component, because at this fire density there is no clean separation between discrete events, which is itself evidence of a spatially contiguous burning field.
Study window. Shrinking the window by 5 and 10 km removes the boundary zone altogether, a stronger check on edge effects than any correction formula. The result is unchanged, so nothing here is manufactured by the translation correction or by the coastal boundary.
Normalisation. normpower = 1 and 2 change the magnitude of \(L_{inhom}\) but not its shape or sign, so the choice is not load-bearing.


点事件定义。 三种单元在 \(\sigma_\lambda = 2\) km 下给出相同答案,都位于包络 之内,\(p\) 介于 0.065 与 0.276 之间。 其中事件单元最关键:它在空间和时间上都已去重,因此不可能受「一场火占据多个 像元」的影响。它的一致性印证了 N2 的「非结果」是检验本身的性质,而不是像元级 重复造成的。
需要说明的是,事件单元本身并不完美。单连接链式合并把全部像元-日的 23% 并进了一个连通分量, 因为在本例的火密度下,离散事件之间没有清晰的分界,而这本身就是「火场在空间上连续 成片」的证据。
研究窗口。 把窗口内缩 5 km 与 10 km 会完全移除边界带,这是比任何校正公式都更强 的边界效应检查。结果不变,因此此处没有任何结论是由平移校正或海岸边界制造出来的。
归一化。 normpower = 1 与 2 改变 \(L_{inhom}\) 的量级,但不改变其形状或 符号,因此这一选择不承重。

section: 6.6 N3: space–time interactionN3:时空交互
text:
6.6 N3: space–time interactionN3:时空交互

Question tested. Are detections that are close in space also close in time, beyond what their separate spatial and temporal patterns imply? Null model N3: random labelling, the observed locations and the observed multiset of dates are both held fixed, and dates are randomly re-assigned to locations (999 permutations) (Knox, 1964).


所检验的问题。 空间上靠近的探测点在时间上是否也靠近,其程度是否超出各自的 空间格局与时间格局所隐含的水平? 零模型 N3: 随机贴标,观测到的位置与观测到的日期多重集都保持固定,只把 日期随机重新分配给各位置(999 次置换)(Knox, 1964)。


This null has a property none of the others has: it requires no model for either marginal pattern, and therefore no bandwidth and no covariates. The spatial configuration is taken as observed, the daily totals are taken as observed, and only their pairing is randomised. That makes it the strongest instrument available here, both because it sidesteps the scale-separation problem that crippled N2, and because § 5.1 showed the daily totals are contaminated by the observation process, which this test conditions on rather than models.


这个零模型有一个其他任何零模型都不具备的性质:它不需要为任一边际格局建模, 因此既不需要带宽,也不需要协变量。空间构型按观测取用,逐日总量按观测取用,只有 两者的配对关系被随机化。这使它成为此处最有力的工具,既因为它绕开了让 N2 瘫痪 的尺度分离问题,也因为 § 5.1 已表明逐日总量受观测过程污染,而本检验是 以它们为条件,而不是对它们建模。



Code
p_k <- SO$knox_res |>
  mutate(space = paste0(space_m / 1000, " km"),
         time = factor(paste0("≤ ", time_d, " day", ifelse(time_d == 1, "", "s")))) |>
  ggplot(aes(time, ratio, fill = space)) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 1, linetype = "22", colour = PAL$theo) +
  geom_col(position = position_dodge(0.8), width = 0.72) +
  geom_text(aes(label = sprintf("%.2f", ratio)),
            position = position_dodge(0.8), vjust = -0.35, size = 2.6,
            colour = PAL$grey) +
  scale_fill_manual("Spatial threshold",
                    values = c(`1 km` = PAL$fire, `2 km` = PAL$fire_l,
                               `5 km` = PAL$grey_l)) +
  scale_y_continuous(expand = expansion(mult = c(0, 0.14))) +
  labs(title = "Observed / expected space-time-close pairs",
       subtitle = "Expected = mean over 999 random re-labellings of the dates",
       x = "Temporal threshold", y = "Ratio") +
  theme_th(10)

p_l <- bind_rows(
  SO$st_by_lag_1km |> mutate(radius = "within 1 km"),
  SO$st_by_lag     |> mutate(radius = "within 5 km")) |>
  ggplot(aes(lag_days, ratio, colour = radius)) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 1, linetype = "22", colour = PAL$theo) +
  geom_line(linewidth = 0.8) +
  geom_point(size = 2.1) +
  scale_colour_manual(NULL, values = c(`within 1 km` = PAL$fire,
                                       `within 5 km` = PAL$water)) +
  scale_x_continuous(breaks = 0:5) +
  labs(title = "Excess by temporal lag",
       subtitle = "Ratio of observed to permuted pair counts at each exact lag",
       x = "Temporal lag (days)", y = "Observed / expected") +
  theme_th(10)

Table 18: Monte-Carlo Knox test. p is the proportion of 999 date permutations producing at least as many space-time-close pairs as observed.蒙特卡洛 Knox 检验。p 为 999 次日期置换中,时空邻近对数不少于观测值的比例。(下表为英文原表)





Nine thresholds, one answer. All nine threshold combinations reject at the permutation floor (\(p\) 0.001), and the excess is sharply graded: within 1 km on the same day the observed count is 1.52× the permuted expectation, against 1.08× at 5 km. The right panel shows the interaction is localised, not merely positive: at 1 km the ratio falls from 1.52 at lag 0 through 1 into a deficit by lag 3 (0.89). Nearby pairs are packed into a two-to-three-day window at the expense of longer lags. Evidence: the null holds both marginals fixed, and unlike N2 it uses no bandwidth and no covariates. Implication: where and when are genuinely dependent, fire predicts fire nearby for about two days. Read with care: this includes a moving front and multi-day smouldering, not only contagion; the lag-0 excess involves distinct locations, so not smouldering alone.


九组阈值,一个答案。 九种阈值组合全部在置换下限上被拒绝 (\(p\) 0.001),而超额呈明显梯度:1 km 内同日的观测数为 置换期望的 1.52×,而 5 km 处为 1.08×。 右图显示这一交互是局域的,而不仅仅是正的:在 1 km 上,比值从滞后 0 的 1.52 穿过 1,到滞后 3 时转为亏缺 (0.89)。邻近点对被压缩进一个两到三天的 窗口内,而这是以更长滞后为代价的。证据: 该零模型固定了两个边际,而且与 N2 不同,它不使用带宽、也不使用协变量。含义: 「哪里」与「何时」确实相互依赖 ,火会在约两天内预示附近再有火。阅读时请留意: 这里面既包含推进的火线,也包含同一片地面 的跨日阴燃,而不只是传染;但滞后 0 的超额涉及的是不同位置,因此并非仅由阴燃 造成。

tibble::tribble(
  ~Null, ~Result, ~`What it establishes`,

title: Take-home Exercise 1: Fire on Drained Peat课后作业一：排水泥炭地上的火
section: 7.1 Why this is worth doing为什么值得做这一步
text:
7.1 Why this is worth doing为什么值得做这一步

§ 6 reached a genuine impasse. Tested against a kernel-based inhomogeneous Poisson null, the pattern is not distinguishable from that null at \(\sigma_\lambda\) = 1–2 km but is decisively distinguishable at 10 km, and the \(p\)-value tracks the null’s flexibility monotonically rather than tracking anything about the data. The obstacle is not the statistic or the number of simulations; it is that a kernel intensity estimate at the clustering scale is an almost-saturated model, so the test has almost no power.
The way out is a null with few parameters. Fitting explicit point-process models supplies exactly that, and in doing so converts an unanswerable question into an answerable one. Three things are gained that the core methods cannot provide.

A multivariate answer on covariates. rhohat (§ 5.5) gives marginal curves, and the four distance covariates are mutually correlated , canals are dug where land is accessible. A marginal canal effect could therefore be an accessibility effect in disguise. ppm holds the others constant.
A test with power. Simulating from a fitted ppm gives null model N4: an inhomogeneous Poisson process whose intensity is driven by measured geography rather than by a kernel smooth of the data itself. It has 5 parameters rather than the ~800 resolution cells a 2 km kernel consumes, so it cannot absorb small-scale clustering. This escapes the scale-separation problem instead of assuming it away.
A generative model with parameters a planner can use. How many distinct clusters, how large each is in metres, how many detections each contains, and how likely two nearby detections are to belong to the same cluster. No summary function yields these.



§ 6 遇到了一个真正的僵局。以基于核的非齐次泊松零模型检验时,该模式在 \(\sigma_\lambda\) = 1–2 km 下与该零模型无法区分,而在 10 km 下则被决定性地 区分开,并且 \(p\) 值单调地追踪零模型的灵活度,而不是追踪关于数据的任何信息。 障碍不在统计量、也不在模拟次数;而在于:在聚集尺度上的核强度估计是一个近乎饱和的 模型,因此检验几乎没有检验力。
出路是使用参数很少的零模型。 拟合显式点过程模型恰好提供了这一点,并由此把一个 无法回答的问题转化为可以回答的问题。相对核心方法,这一步带来三样它们无法提供的 东西。

关于协变量的多变量答案。 rhohat(§ 5.5)给出的是边际曲线, 而四个距离协变量彼此相关,运河是在土地可达的地方开挖的。因此一个边际的运河效应 有可能只是可达性效应的伪装。ppm 能固定其余变量。
一个有检验力的检验。 从已拟合的 ppm 模拟给出零模型 N4:一个非齐次 泊松过程,其强度由已测得的地理条件驱动,而不是由数据自身的核平滑驱动。它只有 5 个参数,而不是 2 km 核所消耗的约 800 个分辨单元, 因此它不可能吸收小尺度聚集。这是绕开了尺度分离问题,而不是把它假设掉。
一个参数可供规划者使用的生成模型。 有多少个不同的簇群、每个有多大(以米计)、 每个包含多少探测,以及两个邻近探测属于同一簇群的可能性有多大。这些是任何汇总 函数都给不出的。

title: Take-home Exercise 1: Fire on Drained Peat课后作业一：排水泥炭地上的火
section: 7.2 Model specification and comparison模型设定与比较
text:
7.2 Model specification and comparison模型设定与比较

Models are fitted by maximum pseudolikelihood on a quadrature scheme (A. Baddeley et al., 2015). Covariates are rescaled from metres to kilometres so that every coefficient reads as a per-kilometre effect.


模型以最大伪似然在一套求积方案上拟合 (A. Baddeley et al., 2015)。协变量由米重标定为公里, 使每个系数都读作「每公里」效应。



Code
Z <- lapply(covars, function(im) eval.im(im / 1000))   # metres -> km

M0  <- ppm(ppp_px ~ 1,        nd = 256)                       # no trend
M1c <- ppm(ppp_px ~ d_canal,  covariates = Z, nd = 256)       # canals only
M1r <- ppm(ppp_px ~ d_river,  covariates = Z, nd = 256)       # rivers only
M1  <- ppm(ppp_px ~ d_canal + d_river + d_road + d_settle,
           covariates = Z, nd = 256)                          # all four
M2  <- ppm(ppp_px ~ polynom(d_canal, 2) + polynom(d_river, 2) +
                    polynom(d_road, 2) + polynom(d_settle, 2),
           covariates = Z, nd = 256)                          # flexible



nd = 256 refines the default quadrature scheme. This matters here: the covariates vary over 250 m while the window is 213 km long, so a coarse scheme would alias the canal signal away.


nd = 256 细化了默认求积方案。这一点在此很关键:协变量在 250 m 尺度上变化, 而窗口长达 213 km,过粗的方案会把运河信号 混叠掉。

  transmute(Model = model, `Parameters` = df, AIC = AIC,
            `ΔAIC vs M0` = dAIC_vs_M0, `ΔAIC vs best` = dAIC_vs_best) |>
  gt::gt() |>

Table 20: Poisson trend models compared by AIC. Each single-covariate model is included to show how much of the total improvement each covariate carries on its own.各泊松趋势模型的 AIC 比较。纳入单协变量模型是为了显示每个协变量单独能贡献多少改进。(下表为英文原表)





Both distance covariates improve enormously on a constant intensity, the full log-linear model improves further, and allowing curvature improves it again, so on fit alone M2 wins. M1 is nonetheless carried forward as the interpretive model, for two reasons. Its coefficients have a single clean reading that a quadratic does not; and M2’s quadratic terms extrapolate pathologically in the tails, giving a fitted intensity range of 37115407709:1 against M1’s 256:1, a warning that the extra flexibility is being spent on sparsely-populated covariate values rather than on the central relationship. Both are tested in § 7.4, and they give the same verdict.


两个距离协变量相对常数强度都带来巨大改进,完整的对数线性模型进一步改进,而允许 曲率又再次改进(因此仅论拟合,M2 胜出。但仍以 M1 作为解释性模型,理由有 两点。其系数有一个干净单一的读法,而二次式没有;并且 M2 的二次项在尾部外推得很 病态,拟合强度范围达 37115407709:1,而 M1 为 256:1)这警示额外的灵活度被 花在了协变量取值稀疏的区域,而不是核心关系上。两者都在 § 7.4 中受检,且给出 相同的判定。

Table 21: M1 coefficients, expressed as the multiplicative change in intensity per additional kilometre of distance. A multiplier below 1 means intensity falls with distance, i.e. fire is concentrated near the feature.M1 的系数,表示为「每增加 1 km 距离,强度的乘性变化」。乘数小于 1 意味着强度随距离下降,即火集中在该地物附近。(下表为英文原表)





The multivariate fit confirms and sharpens the marginal result of § 5.5.

Canals. Intensity is multiplied by 0.885 per additional kilometre from a canal (halving roughly every 5.6 km) with the other three covariates held constant. The canal effect is therefore not an accessibility effect in disguise.
Rivers. The effect runs the other way, and strongly: intensity increases by a factor of 1.196 per kilometre away from a natural river (\(z =\) 29, the largest in the model). This is the report’s clearest mechanistic discrimination: generic proximity to water does not predict fire, and the interior peat away from natural drainage is where fire concentrates.
Roads retain a modest “closer” effect (× 0.948 per km), consistent with human access.
Settlements show a weak effect in the multivariate model (× 1.010 per km, \(z =\) 2.1), notably weaker than the marginal comparison suggested, which is exactly the kind of correction a multivariate model is for.



多变量拟合印证并锐化了 § 5.5 的边际结果。

运河。 在固定其余三个协变量的条件下,距运河每多 1 km,强度乘以 0.885,大约每 5.6 km 减半。因此运河效应不是 可达性效应的伪装。
河流。 效应方向相反,而且很强:距天然河流每远 1 km,强度上升 1.196 倍(\(z =\) 29,为模型中最大)。这是全篇最清晰的机制区分: 泛泛的「靠水」并不预测火,而远离天然排水的内部泥炭才是火集中的地方。
道路保留了一个不大的「更近」效应(每公里 × 0.948),与人为可达性一致。
居民点在多变量模型中效应很弱(每公里 × 1.010,\(z =\) 2.1),明显弱于边际比较所暗示的程度,而这正是多变量 模型存在的意义所在。








WarningThese standard errors are too small



ppm fits by Poisson pseudolikelihood, which assumes conditional independence of points given the trend. The points are demonstrably not independent, that is exactly what § 7.4 below establishes. The point estimates remain consistent, but the standard errors and the \(z\) values above are understated, possibly severely, because the effective sample size is far below 2,715. The coefficients should be read for sign and magnitude, not as calibrated significance tests. The confidence intervals are shown because they convey precision relative to one another, not because their nominal coverage is credible.








Warning这些标准误偏小



ppm 以泊松伪似然拟合,该方法假定在给定趋势的条件下点之间相互独立。而这些点可证地 并不独立。这恰恰是下文 § 7.4 所确立的。点估计仍然是一致的,但上表中的 标准误与 \(z\) 值被低估,可能低估得很严重,因为有效样本量远低于 2,715。因此系数应按符号与量级解读,而不应当作校准过的显著性检验。 展示置信区间是因为它们传达了彼此之间的相对精度,而不是因为其名义覆盖率可信。




Code
k_main <- which(FO_K$sigma_ladder == FO_K$sigma_main)

g1 <- ggplot() +
  geom_raster(data = im_df(VA$trend_M1, "lam", scale = 1e6),
              aes(x, y, fill = lam)) +
  geom_sf(data = bnd, fill = NA, colour = "#1c1917", linewidth = 0.4) +
  scale_fill_fire(name = "per km²", trans = "sqrt",
                  labels = label_number(accuracy = 0.1)) +
  labs(title = "M1: fitted from geography alone",
       subtitle = "Four distance covariates, no reference to where points actually are") +
  theme_map(10)

g2 <- ggplot() +
  geom_raster(data = im_df(FO_K$dens[[k_main]], "lam", scale = 1e6),
              aes(x, y, fill = lam)) +
  geom_sf(data = bnd, fill = NA, colour = "#1c1917", linewidth = 0.4) +
  scale_fill_fire(name = "per km²", trans = "sqrt",
                  labels = label_number(accuracy = 0.1)) +
  labs(title = "Kernel estimate, for comparison",
       subtitle = paste0("σ = ", n_fmt(FO_K$sigma_main), " m (Section 5)")) +
  theme_map(10)

rs <- im_df(VA$res_sm, "res")
g3 <- ggplot() +
  geom_raster(data = rs, aes(x, y, fill = res)) +
  geom_sf(data = bnd, fill = NA, colour = "#1c1917", linewidth = 0.4) +
  scale_fill_gradient2(name = "Pearson\nresidual", low = "#0e7490",
                       mid = "#f5f5f4", high = "#b91c1c", midpoint = 0,
                       na.value = NA) +
  labs(title = "Where M1 is wrong",
       subtitle = "Red: more fire than geography predicts. Blue: less.") +
  theme_map(10)

g1 + g2 + g3 + patchwork::plot_layout(nrow = 1)








Figure 19: Left: intensity predicted by the covariate model M1. Centre: the kernel estimate from Section 5, for comparison. Right: smoothed Pearson residuals of M1, showing where the covariate model is wrong.左:协变量模型 M1 预测的强度。中:第 5 节的核估计,供对比。右:M1 的平滑 Pearson 残差,显示该协变量模型在哪里出错。






Where the model fails. The covariate model reproduces the broad central–southern concentration seen in the kernel estimate, using no information about where the points are, a genuine out-of-sample-flavoured check on the geography story. Its dynamic range is 256:1, comparable to the kernel estimate’s. But the residual map shows systematic failure: the model under-predicts in a focused core (red) and over-predicts across broad areas where canals exist but fire did not occur (blue). Evidence: residuals are spatially structured, not noise, precisely the diagnostic that a Poisson trend model is incomplete (A. Baddeley et al., 2005). Implication: drainage proximity identifies where fire is possible, not where it happens; something concentrates activity within that envelope. One limit: the omitted variables (land cover, peat depth, tenure) are the obvious candidates, so this residual structure is not proof of interaction.


模型在哪里失效。 协变量模型在完全不使用「点在哪里」的信息的情况下,再现了核 估计中那片宽阔的中南部集中带(这是对「地理条件解释」这一说法的一次带有样本外 意味的真实检验。其动态范围为 256:1,与核估计相当。但残差图 显示出系统性失效:模型在一个集中的核心区低估(红),而在大片有运河却没有过火 的区域高估(蓝)。证据: 残差在空间上有结构,而不是噪声)这正是「泊松趋势 模型不完备」的诊断特征 (A. Baddeley et al., 2005)。含义: 运河邻近度识别的是 火在哪里可能发生,而不是它实际在哪里发生;在这个包络之内,还有别的东西在使活动 集中。一点限度: 遗漏变量(土地覆盖、泥炭深度、土地权属)是显而易见的候选,因此这一 残差结构不是交互作用的证明。

text:
7.4 N4: does measured geography explain the clustering?N4:已测得的地理条件能解释聚集吗?

Question tested. Is the observed pattern consistent with an inhomogeneous Poisson process whose intensity is driven by measured drainage and access geography? Null model N4: simulate from the fitted ppm. Unlike N2, the trend here has only four smooth covariates and cannot absorb small-scale clustering, so this test is free of the scale-separation assumption.


所检验的问题。 观测到的模式,是否与一个强度由已测得的排水与可达性地理条件 驱动的非齐次泊松过程相容? 零模型 N4: 从已拟合的 ppm 模拟。与 N2 不同,此处的趋势只有四个平滑协变量, 不可能吸收小尺度聚集,因此本检验不受尺度分离假设的约束。

gp <- function(e, tst, ttl, sub) {
  s <- env_summary(e)
  plot_env_centred(e, title = ttl,
    subtitle = sprintf("%s · DCLF p %s", sub, pv(tst$p.value)),
    ref_lab = "Fitted model") +
    theme_th(10) + theme(legend.position = "none")
}

gp(VA$gof_M1, VA$gof_M1_test, "N4: M1 log-linear trend",
   "Inhomogeneous Poisson, 4 covariates") +
gp(VA$gof_M2, VA$gof_M2_test, "N4b: M2 flexible trend",
   "Inhomogeneous Poisson, quadratic") +
gp(VA$gof_M3, VA$gof_M3_test, "N5: M3 Thomas cluster process",
   "Trend + explicit clustering") +
  patchwork::plot_layout(nrow = 1)

Table 22: Formal goodness-of-fit tests against each fitted model, 199 simulations each.针对每个已拟合模型的正式拟合优度检验,各 199 次模拟。(下表为英文原表)





Both Poisson trend models are rejected decisively, and M3 is not (\(p =\) 0.69). That contrast is the substantive resolution of § 6’s impasse:

A smooth, geography-driven intensity cannot reproduce the observed second-order structure.
The same trend plus a two-parameter clustering mechanism can.

So the structure at a few kilometres is real, is not explained by mapped drainage and access, and is well described as clustering. Note what made this possible: not better data or more simulations, but a null model parsimonious enough to be falsifiable. Fig. 16 placed these models at the far-left, high-power end of the same axis on which the kernel nulls of § 6 sit.


两个泊松趋势模型都被决定性地拒绝,而 M3 没有被拒绝(\(p =\) 0.69)。这一反差正是对 § 6 那个僵局的 实质性破解:

一个平滑的、由地理条件驱动的强度无法再现观测到的二阶结构。
而同一个趋势再加上一个两参数的聚集机制可以。

因此,数公里尺度上的结构是真实的、无法由已制图的排水与可达性解释,并且用「聚集」 来描述是恰当的。请注意促成这一点的并不是更好的数据或更多的模拟,而是一个简约到 足以被伪证的零模型。Fig. 16 把这些模型放在了与 § 6 的核零模型同一条轴上, 位于最左侧、检验力最高的一端。

title: Take-home Exercise 1: Fire on Drained Peat课后作业一：排水泥炭地上的火
section: 7.5 M3: a generative model of the clusteringM3:聚集的生成模型
text:
7.5 M3: a generative model of the clusteringM3:聚集的生成模型

A Thomas cluster process supposes unobserved “parent” locations at intensity \(\kappa\), each producing a random number of “offspring” scattered isotropically about it with standard deviation scale. Read substantively on this landscape, parents are ignition foci, offspring are the detections they generate, and scale is the effective physical size of a burning patch. The trend is taken from M1, so the model says: fire opportunity is set by drainage and access geography; within that, fire arrives in clusters.


Thomas 聚集过程假设存在强度为 \(\kappa\) 的、未被观测到的「母点」位置,每个母点 产生随机数量的「子点」,以标准差 scale 各向同性地散布在其周围。在本景观上按实质 含义解读:母点是点火焦点,子点是它们所产生的探测,而 scale 是一片燃烧斑块 的有效物理尺寸。趋势取自 M1,因此该模型表述的是:火的机会由排水与可达性地理 条件决定;在此之内,火以簇群形式出现。



Code
VA$clust_tab |>
  gt::gt() |>
  gt::cols_label(quantity = "Parameter", value = "Fitted value") |>
  gt::tab_options(table.font.size = gt::pct(85), data_row.padding = gt::px(5))











Parameter
Fitted value




kappa: parent intensity
1.22e-09 per m2 (1.22 per 1,000 km2)


implied number of clusters in the window
12


scale: cluster standard deviation
2142 m


~68% of offspring within
2.1 km of the parent


~95% of offspring within
4.3 km of the parent


mu: mean offspring per parent
229 detections


phi: cluster strength
14.25


psib: sibling probability
0.934








Table 23: Fitted Thomas process parameters, with their substantive reading.拟合出的 Thomas 过程参数及其实质含义。(下表为英文原表)





The parameters give a quantitative picture that none of the summary functions produced:

Roughly 12 distinct clusters across 9,759 km², i.e. about 1.2 per 1,000 km².
A cluster scale of 2,140 m, so about 68% of the detections belonging to a cluster lie within 2.1 km of its centre and 95% within 4.3 km.
About 229 detections per cluster on average.
A sibling probability of 0.93: given two detections close together, that is the probability they belong to the same cluster rather than being independent neighbours. At 93%, nearby detections are overwhelmingly the same event.







WarningNot all four numbers are equally well determined



Minimum-contrast fitting matches the model’s pair correlation function to the observed one over the fitted range of \(r\). That range constrains the scale tightly (it is essentially the distance at which the observed excess pairing dies away), but it constrains \(\kappa\) and \(\mu\) only through their product, which is the point intensity the trend has already fixed. The two therefore trade off against each other: a fit with more, smaller clusters and one with fewer, larger ones produce nearly the same pair correlation function. At a sibling probability of 0.93 the fit sits deep in that regime.
The consequence for reading the table: 2.1 km is a finding. “About 12 clusters” is the model’s accounting, not a count of fires. It is the parent intensity that this particular parameterisation needs in order to reproduce the observed clumping at that scale, and it should not be quoted as an estimate of how many distinct fires burned. The same reservation applies to the \(\Delta\)AIC values in Tbl. 20: they are computed from a Poisson likelihood and inherit exactly the independence assumption that this section has just rejected, so they rank the trend models sensibly but overstate how decisive the differences are.


The N5 test does not reject this model (\(p =\) 0.69): a Thomas process with a geography-driven trend reproduces the observed \(L(r)\) across the whole 0–15 km range. Two caveats keep this in proportion. A non-rejection is not proof of mechanism, other cluster processes would fit comparably, and the “parents” are a mathematical device, not observed ignition points. And the fitted scale is close to the 2 km kernel bandwidth at which the N2 test lost power, which is exactly what one would expect if the same structure is being described twice in different languages.


这些参数给出了任何汇总函数都未能给出的定量图景:

在 9,759 km² 范围内约有 12 个不同的簇群,即每千 km² 约 1.2 个。
簇群尺度为 2,140 m,因此属于某簇群的探测约有 68% 落在其中心 2.1 km 以内,95% 落在 4.3 km 以内。
平均每个簇群约 229 个探测。
同胞概率为 0.93:给定两个彼此靠近的探测,这是它们 属于同一簇群(而非各自独立的邻居)的概率。在 93% 的水平上,邻近探测绝大多数是同一个事件。







Warning这四个数字的确定程度并不相同



最小对比拟合是在拟合所用的 \(r\) 区间上,让模型的配对相关函数去匹配观测到的那一条。 该区间把 scale 约束得很紧(它本质上就是观测到的超额成对消失的那个距离)但它 对 \(\kappa\) 与 \(\mu\) 的约束,只通过两者的乘积,而乘积正是趋势项已经定下的点 强度。因此二者会相互权衡:「更多更小的簇」与「更少更大的簇」两种拟合,会给出几乎 相同的配对相关函数。在兄弟概率为 0.93 时,本拟合正处在这个 区间的深处。
由此得出读表的方式:2.1 km 是一项发现; 而「约 12 个簇群」是模型的记账方式,不是火的计数 。它只是这一特定参数化为了在该尺度上再现观测到的成团所需要的母点强度,不应被当作 「烧了多少场不同的火」的估计来引用。同样的保留适用于 Tbl. 20 中的 \(\Delta\)AIC: 它们由泊松似然算出,继承的正是上文刚刚拒绝掉的独立性假设,因此它们对趋势模型的排序 是合理的,但会夸大这些差异的决定性。


N5 检验不拒绝该模型(\(p =\) 0.69):一个带有地理驱动趋势的 Thomas 过程 在整个 0–15 km 范围上再现了观测到的 \(L(r)\)。有两点告示让这一结论保持在应有的分量 上。不拒绝不是机制的证明,其他聚集过程也会拟合得差不多好,而「母点」是一个 数学装置,不是被观测到的点火位置。并且拟合出的 scale 接近 N2 检验丧失检验力时的 2 km 核带宽,而如果同一个结构正被用两种语言描述两次,这恰恰是我们应当预期的结果。



Code
prd <- VA$parres[!vapply(VA$parres, is.null, logical(1))]
if (length(prd)) {
  pl <- bind_rows(lapply(names(prd), function(nm) {
    d <- as.data.frame(prd[[nm]])
    tibble(covariate = nm, x = d[[1]], h = d$h, fit = d$fit,
           lo = d$lo, hi = d$hi)
  }))
  lbl2 <- c(d_canal = "Distance to canal (km)",
            d_river = "Distance to river (km)",
            d_road  = "Distance to road (km)",
            d_settle = "Distance to settlement (km)")
  ggplot(pl, aes(x)) +
    geom_ribbon(aes(ymin = lo, ymax = hi), fill = PAL$fire_xl, alpha = 0.7) +
    geom_line(aes(y = fit), linetype = "22", colour = PAL$theo,
              linewidth = 0.5) +
    geom_line(aes(y = h), colour = PAL$fire, linewidth = 0.8) +
    facet_wrap(~covariate, scales = "free", nrow = 1,
               labeller = labeller(covariate = lbl2)) +
    labs(title = "Is a straight line on the log scale good enough?",
         subtitle = "Solid: partial residual fit. Dashed: the log-linear term actually fitted.",
         x = NULL, y = "Partial residual (log intensity)") +
    theme_th(10)
} else {
  cat("Partial residuals unavailable.")
}








Figure 21: Partial residuals for each covariate in M1: the non-parametric shape of the effect after the other three are accounted for (solid), against the fitted log-linear form (dashed).M1 中各协变量的偏残差:在扣除其余三个协变量后该效应的非参数形状(实线),与实际拟合的对数线性形式(虚线)对比。






Checking the functional form. Where the solid curve tracks the dashed line, the log-linear form is adequate; where it departs, the effect is really curved. The canal effect is close to log-linear over the range containing most of the window, which is what licenses the “halves every 5.6 km” reading in the coefficient table. The departures are largest at the far tails, where few locations exist and the bands are wide. Evidence: this is consistent with M2’s better AIC arising from tail behaviour rather than from the central relationship being misspecified. A caveat: partial residuals inherit the Poisson independence assumption, so the bands are again too narrow.


检验函数形式。 实线跟随虚线的地方,说明对数线性形式是够用的;偏离的地方, 说明该效应确实是弯曲的。运河效应在覆盖窗口大部分取值的范围内接近对数线性,这正是 系数表中「每 5.6 km 减半」这一读法得以 成立的依据。偏离最大的地方在远端尾部,那里位置样本很少、置信带很宽。证据: 这与「M2 更优的 AIC 来自尾部行为、而非核心关系被错误设定」相一致。一点保留: 偏残差 继承了泊松独立性假设,因此这些置信带同样偏窄。

title: Take-home Exercise 1: Fire on Drained Peat课后作业一：排水泥炭地上的火
section: 8.2 How the first- and second-order findings complement each other一阶与二阶发现如何互补
text:
8.2 How the first- and second-order findings complement each other一阶与二阶发现如何互补

The first-order analysis locates the hazard; it cannot explain its concentration. The intensity surface (Fig. 8) says fire is in the central–southern regency, and the covariate analysis (Fig. 11) says that is where the engineered drainage is. But an intensity surface is agnostic about mechanism: a 39-fold intensity range is equally consistent with “many independent ignitions in a favourable environment” and with “a few ignitions that spread”.


一阶分析定位了灾害,但无法解释它为何集中。 强度面(Fig. 8)告诉我们火在该县中南部, 协变量分析(Fig. 11)告诉我们那里正是人工排水所在之处。但强度面对机制是不置可否的:约 39 倍的强度变化幅度,既与「在有利环境中有许多相互独立 的点火」相容,也与「少数点火随后蔓延」同样相容。


The second-order analysis distinguishes those two, but only once the null model is chosen well enough to have power. This is the pivot of the whole report, and it is worth stating plainly:

Against a kernel intensity at 1–2 km, the pattern is consistent with an inhomogeneous Poisson process (Fig. 15). That is not evidence of independence; it is a test with almost no power, because a 2 km kernel over this window has roughly 777 resolution cells for 2,715 points.
Against a 5-parameter covariate trend, the pattern is decisively not Poisson (\(p\) 0.003).
Adding a two-parameter clustering mechanism to that same trend produces a model that fits (\(p =\) 0.69).



二阶分析能区分这两者,但前提是零模型选得足够好、具备检验力。 这是整份报告的 枢轴,值得直白地写出来:

相对 1–2 km 的核强度,该模式确实与非齐次泊松过程相容(Fig. 15)。这不是独立性的 证据;这是一个几乎没有检验力的检验,因为 2 km 的核在本窗口上约有 777 个分辨单元, 而点只有 2,715 个。
相对一个 5 参数的协变量趋势,该模式则决定性地不是 泊松(\(p\) 0.003)。
在同一趋势上再加入一个两参数的聚集机制,得到的模型拟合良好 (\(p =\) 0.69)。



Together they give a two-layer account. Drainage and access geography set where fire is possible, the first-order layer, whose residual map (Fig. 21) shows it works as an envelope but over-predicts broadly across canal-rich areas that did not burn. Within that envelope fire arrives in compact clusters of roughly 2.1 km scale (Tbl. 23), and those clusters are organised in time as well as in space. Neither layer alone is the phenomenon.


两者合起来给出一个两层的解释。 排水与可达性地理条件决定了火在哪里可能 发生。这是一阶层,残差图(Fig. 21)显示它作为一个「包络」是有效的,但在大片有 运河却没有过火的区域会过度预测。在这个包络之内,火以约 2.1 km 尺度的紧凑簇群出现(Tbl. 23),而这些簇群在时间上 和空间上同样是有组织的。任何单独一层都不是这个现象本身。


The whole sequence of reference models, and the verdict each returned, is drawn in Fig. 22. Ordering the rungs by how flexible the null is (rather than by the order in which they were tried) is what makes the problem visible: the verdict rises and falls with the null model, not with the data, until the family is changed rather than the flexibility dial.


整套参照模型及各自给出的判定,绘制在 Fig. 22 中。把各级按零模型的灵活度 排序(而不是按尝试的先后)正是让问题显形的关键:判定随零模型上下浮动,而不是 随数据变化,直到换掉的是模型族而非灵活度旋钮为止。








FITSThomas cluster process · same covariate trendcompact clusters, σ̂ ≈ 2.1 km · a parsimonious null that survivedREJECTEDParametric Poisson · distance to canal, river, road, settlementfalsifiable, and falsified: measured geography is not the whole storyRESOLUTION · CHANGE THE FAMILY, NOT THE FLEXIBILITY DIALNOT REJECTEDKernel inhomogeneous Poisson · σ = 1–2 kmthe flexible null absorbs the clustering it was meant to test forREJECTEDKernel inhomogeneous Poisson · σ = 10 kmdecisively, but only because the null was too smooth to competeSame data, same statistic, opposite verdicts: an identifiability and power problem, not a findingREJECTEDbut uninformativeHomogeneous Poisson (CSR) · constant intensitynobody believed it; rejecting it answers no research questionFLEXIBILITY OF THE NULL MODELLeast flexible at the bottom. The verdict rises and falls with the null, which is why a parametric family was needed to break the tie.拟合Thomas 聚集过程 · 同一套协变量趋势紧凑簇群,σ̂ ≈ 2.1 km · 一个撑住了的简约零模型被拒绝参数化泊松 · 到运河、河流、道路、聚落的距离可被伪证,且确实被伪证:已测得的地理条件不是全部破解 · 换一个模型族,而不是拧灵活度旋钮不被拒绝核估计非齐次泊松 · σ = 1–2 km灵活的零模型把它本该检验的聚集自己吸收掉了被拒绝核估计非齐次泊松 · σ = 10 km被决定性地拒绝,但只因为这个零模型太平滑,竞争不过同一份数据、同一个统计量,相反的判定:这是可识别性与检验力问题,不是一项发现被拒绝但没有信息量齐次泊松(CSR) · 强度为常数没人相信它;拒绝它回答不了任何一个研究问题零模型的灵活度越往下越不灵活。判定随零模型上下浮动,这正是为什么必须换一个参数化模型族来打破平局。




Figure 22: The null-model ladder. Rungs are ordered by the flexibility of the null, not by the order tried. The boxed pair is the identifiability problem: the same data and the same statistic give opposite verdicts at two intensity bandwidths.零模型阶梯。各级按零模型的灵活度排序, 而非按尝试顺序。方框圈出的那一对就是可识别性问题:同一份数据、同一个统计量,在两个 强度带宽下给出相反的判定。









ImportantThe methodological lesson, stated once



Whether the few-kilometre structure in this pattern is called “fine-scale intensity variation” or “clustering” is not decidable from one realisation. Those are two descriptions of the same data, and the kernel-based test simply relabels the structure according to how flexible the analyst allows the intensity estimate to be.
What is decidable, and what this report establishes, is narrower and more useful: the structure at a few kilometres is not accounted for by the drainage, road, river and settlement geography that was measured, and it is organised in time. Both of those conclusions come from null models that require no bandwidth at all.








Important方法学教训,只说一次



本模式中那个数公里尺度的结构,该叫它「细尺度强度变化」还是「聚集」, 从单次实现中无法判定。这是对同一批数据的两种描述,而基于核的检验只是按分析者 允许强度估计有多灵活,来给这个结构重新贴标签。
可以判定、也是这项分析真正确立的结论,更窄,但更有用:那个数公里尺度的结构 无法由已测得的排水、道路、河流与居民点地理条件解释,而且它在时间上是有组织 的。这两个结论都来自完全不需要带宽的零模型。



This has an immediate operational consequence, developed in § 10: a static risk map derived from drainage geography identifies roughly the right envelope but is poorly calibrated within it, whereas a rule that also responds to recent detections exploits the space–time dependence.


这有一个直接的操作后果,详见 § 10：一张由排水地理条件推导出的静态 风险图能大致识别出正确的包络,但在包络内部校准很差;而一个同时响应近期探测的 规则则利用了时空依赖。
